name: David Kim
subject: Join Me This Weekend for Canvassing and Coffee!
body:
I need your help! Groups like AIPAC have pledged $100 million to defeat progressive candidates across the country, starting right here in CA-34. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/davidkimforca/join-me-this-weekend-for-canvassing-and-coffee?e=fee98d637f)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friends,

In our fight for a just and equitable future, we face an uphill battle against powerful forces. Groups like[ AIPAC have pledged $100 million ](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=bce50bbeee&e=fee98d637f)to defeat progressive candidates across the country, starting right here in CA-34. They have already funneled hundreds of thousands of dollars into the campaign of my opponent, Jimmy Gomez. This dark money is aimed at silencing our movement and maintaining the status quo.

But we won’t let them. Our campaign is built on the strength of our community and our collective resolve to create real change. To counter their influence, we need to out-organize and out-mobilize, focusing on connections with our neighbors. This weekend is a crucial step in our journey, and I’m inviting you to join me for two important events.
---
|
---
| | _**Canvassing**_

On Saturday and Sunday, we’ll be hitting the streets to knock on doors and spread our message of hope and progress. Your participation is vital to building the momentum we need to overcome the corporate-backed interests trying to drown out our voices. **Saturday, June 22nd @__****_1:00pm_
Sunday, June 23rd @_10:00am_
Meeting Point: Provided upon sign-up** **Sign Up HERE:[ https://airtable.com/appUVRSLvokr25WbV/shr1I3I8p0fYmhzX9](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=079b4d3769&e=fee98d637f)**
---
| | _**Candidate Coffee with David Kim**_

Before we knock doors on Saturday, join me for a "Candidate Coffee" session. This informal gathering is a chance for us to talk about the issues that matter most to you. It’s a moment to share ideas, voice concerns, and build the community spirit that fuels our campaign.

**Date: Saturday, June 22nd
Time: 10:30am - 12:30pm
Location: Provided upon rsvp** ******RSVP for Candidate Coffee:**[****](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=84378f6029&e=fee98d637f)**[https://airtable.com/appOw277ZgHHJJJtP/pagfQnFZWJJVNRjOz/form](https://davidkimforca.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c05fe848bb5af5e7b9d690b2f&id=029be2d124&e=fee98d637f)**
---
| Together, we can overcome the influence of dark money and special interests by building a campaign rooted in people power. Your involvement, whether it's knocking on doors or sharing your story over coffee, makes all the difference.

I’m looking forward to seeing you this weekend as we take this crucial step toward victory and a brighter future for all of us in Los Angeles.

It’s Time For Us,

David Kim
Candidate for Congress, CA-34
---
|

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? body:
As a gay man, this means so much to me.

name: Andrew Yang
subject: Where We Are
body:
| |
---
| | |
---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=6b51d0f42a&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
Hello, I hope that your summer is going great.

If you haven’t seen it, I highly recommend **[Scott Galloway’s recent TED Talk](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=641092bacd&e=0f227c2ae3)**, and not just because I make a couple cameos. He hits on many themes of my presidential campaign concerning negative trends in the economy and our standard of living, particularly for young people. I often said on the trail, “If you’re young you are entirely justified in being either angry or sad, because we have left you with a real mess and also the bill.”

Things have gotten far worse for young people over the past five years, as our country has ramped up debt very significantly while making things like housing dramatically less affordable. It’s one of the great megatrends in my thinking over the last five years.

1. Things are getting progressively worse for most Americans based on affordability, and that needs to change;

2. Our institutions are designed to resist change in favor of the status quo that serves vested interests quite well; and

3. We need to build a movement that changes the institutions or goes around them if we are going to change #1.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=41dc036687&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
| During my presidential campaign we activated almost half a million donors and millions more who were eager to see something big change in favor of people. You are probably among that number if you’re reading this – thank you! Our campaign fell short, and now I’m grinding away at changing #2. Someone said to me today, “I just figured out why you’re going so heavy on ranked choice voting, and I’m on board.”

Every day, people come up to me and say “Run again!” in part because they are fed up by what we are getting. At the same time, if I had run again in this context I would likely do more harm than good. It’s one reason I was so glad to back Dean Phillips, who I saw as a responsible way to upgrade from a Biden versus Trump rematch and give us all a shot at a better future. Watching the way the media and the Democrats sidelined Dean was a stark reminder of #2 above, despite the fact that Dean was clearly benevolent and a Democrat in good standing before he made the decision to put country ahead of party.

Forward has now gotten behind candidates like John Avlon, John Curtis, Shelane Etchison and Adam Frisch, all of whom I’m very excited about. There are also local candidates in Nevada, Pennsylvania, Florida and around the country. I’m glad to do good where I can.

But the backdrop of Scott’s talk and my presidential campaign was of a system that has gotten increasingly dysfunctional and punitive for the average American and young people in particular. I was with Tim Ryan from Ohio last week, and he put it like this: “If I lost my job at the plant or my town has been going downhill for years and you come and tell me GDP has had a good couple quarters, it doesn’t make me want to vote for you.” Ohio of course has gone from a swing state to quite red in the past decade-plus.

I think that Trump would make a disastrous President, much worse than he was last time. I’m angry and sad that he may be on the verge of returning, in part because the Democrats have set the stage for it.

What do you do in an age of declining institutions? You take them over if you can, and build new ones as quickly as possible.

To check out what Forward is doing including the candidates above, click **[here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=e48cb3ade8&e=0f227c2ae3)**. If you are in position to donate click **[here](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=104b0cc7ee&e=0f227c2ae3)** – we are very grateful for your support!

For those of you who follow the podcast, we are doing a special Q&A episode – submit your question at **[mailbag@andrewyang.com](mailto:mailbag@andrewyang.com)** and we will answer the good ones on air.

**[My TED Talk](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=93d798c050&e=0f227c2ae3)** is now up to 1.4 million views and counting - thanks for helping get it out there!
---

Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party

clean_body: | | | | | | | Hello, I hope that your summer is going great. If you haven’t seen it, I highly recommend , and not just because I make a couple cameos. He hits on many themes of my presidential campaign concerning negative trends in the economy and our standard of living, particularly for young people. I often said on the trail, “If you’re young you are entirely justified in being either angry or sad, because we have left you with a real mess and also the bill.” Things have gotten far worse for young people over the past five years, as our country has ramped up debt very significantly while making things like housing dramatically less affordable. It’s one of the great megatrends in my thinking over the last five years. 1. Things are getting progressively worse for most Americans based on affordability, and that needs to change; 2. Our institutions are designed to resist change in favor of the status quo that serves vested interests quite well; and 3. We need to build a movement that changes the institutions or goes around them if we are going to change #1. | | During my presidential campaign we activated almost half a million donors and millions more who were eager to see something big change in favor of people. You are probably among that number if you’re reading this – thank you! Our campaign fell short, and now I’m grinding away at changing #2. Someone said to me today, “I just figured out why you’re going so heavy on ranked choice voting, and I’m on board.” Every day, people come up to me and say “Run again!” in part because they are fed up by what we are getting. At the same time, if I had run again in this context I would likely do more harm than good. It’s one reason I was so glad to back Dean Phillips, who I saw as a responsible way to upgrade from a Biden versus Trump rematch and give us all a shot at a better future. Watching the way the media and the Democrats sidelined Dean was a stark reminder of #2 above, despite the fact that Dean was clearly benevolent and a Democrat in good standing before he made the decision to put country ahead of party. Forward has now gotten behind candidates like John Avlon, John Curtis, Shelane Etchison and Adam Frisch, all of whom I’m very excited about. There are also local candidates in Nevada, Pennsylvania, Florida and around the country. I’m glad to do good where I can. But the backdrop of Scott’s talk and my presidential campaign was of a system that has gotten increasingly dysfunctional and punitive for the average American and young people in particular. I was with Tim Ryan from Ohio last week, and he put it like this: “If I lost my job at the plant or my town has been going downhill for years and you come and tell me GDP has had a good couple quarters, it doesn’t make me want to vote for you.” Ohio of course has gone from a swing state to quite red in the past decade-plus. I think that Trump would make a disastrous President, much worse than he was last time. I’m angry and sad that he may be on the verge of returning, in part because the Democrats have set the stage for it. What do you do in an age of declining institutions? You take them over if you can, and build new ones as quickly as possible. To check out what Forward is doing including the candidates above, click . If you are in position to donate click – we are very grateful for your support! For those of you who follow the podcast, we are doing a special Q&A episode – submit your question at mailto:mailbag@andrewyang.com and we will answer the good ones on air. is now up to 1.4 million views and counting - thanks for helping get it out there! | Andrew Yang Co-Chair, Forward Party | | | Want to change how you receive these emails? It’s been a busy week in Wisconsin! Here’s an update from the campaign trail. | | | | |
---
| It’s been a busy week in Wisconsin!
Here’s an update from the campaign trail.
**President Trump Is Visiting Racine** Tomorrow, President Trump will be holding a rally at Racine Festival Park. The doors open at 11:00 a.m. and President Trump will begin speaking at 3:00 p.m.
**I look forward to joining President Trump on stage** and contrasting the failed policies of the Biden Administration with the pro-growth policies of Republicans.
There’s still time to register for the rally. Click the link below to sign up!
---
[Click Here to Register for the Rally!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=672a729610&e=e907534017)
| When I speak with President Trump tomorrow, who should I tell him the people of Wisconsin support for Vice President?
Fill out the survey below, and let me know who you support!
---
[Fill Out This Survey! ](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=3a409f9428&e=e907534017)
| **New Attack Ad** Last week, a dark money group spent another $300,000 on an attack ad against me.
In total, dark money groups have now spent **$2.6 million attacking me on Milwaukee TV this cycle.** And we don’t anticipate the attacks to slow down.
The First District is one of the most competitive districts in country. And it’s crucial we perform well in southeastern Wisconsin if we want to keep the House, take back the Senate, and elect President Trump.
If you’re able and willing, any support you can show our campaign will help me get my message out and fight back against these attack ads.
---
[Click Here to Donate to My Campaign!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=823d7fbb3a&e=e907534017)
| **Holding The Biden Administration Accountable** Last week, I subpoenaed 15 members of Biden’s Cabinet for documents related to President Biden’s recent executive order that authorizes taxpayer dollars to be used by federal agencies to get-out-the-vote across the country.
These are also known as Bidenbucks.
If left unchecked, taxpayer dollars could be used by partisan federal agencies in voter registration and ultimately influence our elections.
---
[Click Here to Read More!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=3d759072d1&e=e907534017)
| **Walworth and Kenosha County Dairy Breakfasts** June is dairy month in Wisconsin, and there was no better place to be this weekend than the Kenosha County and Walworth County dairy breakfasts!
Thank you to the Davis Farm in Sharon and the Crane Grain Farm in Salem for your generous hospitality this weekend!
---

---
|
---
|
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

Friends, it’s time we talk about Donald Trump’s criminal conviction in the hush money trial and what (if any) impact this will have on the November election.
Last month in New York, a jury of Trump’s peers found him guilty on all 34 counts in his plot to illegally influence the 2016 election by paying off Stormy Daniels – making him the first former president to become a convicted felon.
This trial was necessary to ensure Trump was held accountable for his actions – and our court system worked as it should to deliver justice.
But like many of you, I find myself wondering: Will it make any difference when it comes to November?
I would love to think that any reasonable person would see these guilty verdicts as an off-ramp for their support of Trump. But the fact is that for much of the GOP, it’s politically safer to stay in line behind Trump than show any moral clarity and potentially risk losing power.
If we want a reckoning for Donald Trump and MAGAism, it’s up to us to deliver it.
To do that, Democrats need to step up our fundraising and get more aggressive with our voter outreach plans – but I need your help. Will you pitch in $25 or whatever you can to my re-election campaign to help defeat my MAGA opponent and flip the House blue?
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=25]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=100]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Look, Republicans have been talking a big game about Donald Trump for nearly a decade, ever since he announced his first presidential run in 2015.
From that primary race to his 2016 win, throughout his first term, and especially in the weeks and months after the January 6th insurrection, people from Mitch McConnell to Mike Pence to RNC leadership have had plenty to say about standing up to Trump.
Unfortunately, we know now that all of it is BS.
Time and time again, those same Republicans realize Trump still holds a lot of power – from money to cultural impact to control over the party infrastructure. So they promptly lose their spines and fall back in line.
Their cowardice and personal political ambition continues to make space for countless Trump-loving, right-wing extremists to rise up, find a platform, and run for office – just like my opponent.
So here’s the deal: We might be sick of hearing about Donald Trump (I know I am). But we have to keep talking about his dangerous rhetoric, the crimes he’s been found guilty of, the three other criminal cases he has pending, and what’s at stake if he gets the chance to enact his anti-democratic plans in November.
We have to do all of that and more if we’re going to defeat him – and win in every race where a MAGA, right-wing candidate is vying for power.
Are you with me? Click here to chip in. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thanks so much for your support.
-Sara

Yesterday, I spent Father's Day doing what I wanted to do as it is the one day that all fathers get a break from their wives. I am in the primary fight to challenge Jim Himes. Every day we are out there meeting potential voters which is important, but having fun is critical to my campaign.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=145726789&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1NzI2Nzg5LCJpYXQiOjE3MTg2Nzg5MjAsImV4cCI6MTcyMTI3MDkyMCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.V_xodHBY8ZOG0y_rf3e4RTMgDtkefSCoa9vY-znJJS8)

| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2dd826fd-18e1-4df4-8928-fd1c4d8c648c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We went out and we campaigned. We went to a car show and a rally and then we went out for dinner. I did fit a trip into Costco (more for a happy wife/happy life insurance plan) and talked to some voters even at Costco loading up for the father's day cookouts.
This campaign is a family affair spending time with my children, sometimes on the trail and always at family dinners and other functions. Talking to voters, whether they're Republican, Democrat, affiliated or not yet registered the message is clear that family is incredibly important, and even now more than ever.
It was fun to spend the day in New Canaan checking out some really cool, classic and new cars, American and imported. It's nice when people come up to you and thank you for taking the chance to run for office. Being at a car show, which is incredibly American to me, it is symbolic of our American roots that a dream and perseverance can lead to a new nation and inspire creativity that has resulted in some amazing achievements such as the American Automobile Industry. We here in Connecticut also inspired the American Space industry and were critical in putting a man on the moon and developing telescopes to see what is beyond Earth.
Today, it is unfortunate that those cars all run on premium fuel and it's even expensive to participate in a car show as most participants came from far and wide. However, plenty of people came out with their carbureted or fuel injected cars and motorcycles to have a good time. It was a high-octane Caffeine & Carburetors Car Show for me to get energized and enjoy a beautiful Sunday.
This campaign has been all about getting back to Faith, Family and Country and meeting voters at their level and the issues that matter to them. When they see I am a doctor, we keep hearing about incredible health costs and I talk about how I can make a difference as a physician and former medical society president.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ee7b6e69-9309-48a1-ab34-0f7838cf4880?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I've been tested by medical societies. I've been battle tested by insurance companies. I have also been battle tested by my patients. The one constant response is that everybody wants a Doctor in the House. Last week there were hearings with Dr. Fauci and Representative McCormick, who is a veteran and physician. He was able to really put some light onto the healthcare issues created by the pandemic. Without physicians in Congress, especially conservative ones that are more likely to stand up for health and medical freedom, this country is doomed. Too many physicians succumbed to pressure and fear during the pandemic.
I know that together we can win in August at the primary and take on my democrat opponent in November. We can make health and wellness more cost-effective and reduce unnecessary administrative burdens. Covid created one of the greatest mental and physical health crises that we will be paying for over the next decade or longer. I know that we can end this crisis quicker by bringing awareness, identifying issues earlier, restoring parental rights and reducing fentanyl at the border. These deaths by fentanyl must be stopped. Having Narcan available is helpful but it is not the solution as so little fentanyl is lethal.
We also have to make life affordable again, which is one of the major causes of mental health and other addictive behaviors as the oppressive nature of inflation at the gas pumps and the grocery stores coupled with the increased healthcare and pharmaceutical costs stress our families in ways they are not prepared for. This state and our country are riddled with increase costs and jobs are not adjusting to the new demand on inflation as many of these employers are struggling as well. This inflation and energy is another main issue for Nutm

I'm sure that like me you miss the strong leadership and winning policies we saw under President Trump... And the prosperity that all American's experienced under his administration. name: Hillsdale College via ICYMI News
subject: You and I can’t let them down now
body:
K-12 education in America is at a crisis point.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8iapvjin17sarc8ptlglb2iglq2n7b5d44qe130_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg62o72cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

K-12 education in America is at a crisis point. And students in classrooms all across this country need your help.

My name is Bill Gray, and I work at Hillsdale College.

**Have you seen how activists and education bureaucrats in our nation have taken over K-12 schools? They are pushing to replace the idea of equal individual rights and replace them with a more destructive idea: unequal rights based on identity.**

**You can see how they do this using critical race theory and other Marxist ideologies.**

**And they 're undoubtedly doing so in K-12 classrooms in your community.**

That's why today, I'm asking you to help us provide pocket Constitutions for young students. These vital founding documents will help them learn about America's founding documents and history--right from the source.

Even a small gift can go a long way:
* [$15 can provide booklets to 75 students](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zt90552sf3bcd13koo2e449unf0g7l13i39vksj8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg62o72cth2bs),
* [$25 reaches and teaches 125 students](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zst3snd3sutkfpepi14f1h7aqnvol7k8d72mmp88_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg62o72cth2bs),
* [$35 reaches and teaches 175 students](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmr61qnen62ulfe5fedu8lts3fttk9if5fmm0m58_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg62o72cth2bs),
* [$50 helps 250 students](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zt4f7f2r5f5116t63vlcja8b8k26ogs78as57or0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg62o72cth2bs).

I'm sure you agree that efforts like this are more important than ever. We need more and more K-12 students reading and understanding the Constitution and Declaration if we're to save America.

It isn't a secret that American civics education--education in American history and government--has been abandoned in far too many of our schools. We've seen how hundreds of thousands of young people are unaware of the importance of the Constitution to liberty. This threatens freedom itself!

Can you help us do something about this knowledge gap? **With your help, we can take action.**

When we send out pocket-sized Constitutions that YOU provide to teachers, principals, and administrators across the country, we make an important promise...

_ To send as many pocket Constitutions as needed so that they can teach their students about our nation's founding principles of liberty!_

You may be encouraged by this...we receive requests for more pocket Constitutions weekly. That's a sign that there is hope for education in America. After all, great teachers know how important it is for their students to receive a proper civics education.

And, when you help, you'll also be helping these students. Most of the high school students who send us letters take a moment to say how excited they were to learn about America's founding documents. **[Here's a copy of one letter from a high school senior named Ava that you can read for yourself](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8ddh5v26u0p9314rvk2b7u4ld8407l4nj3nedfg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg62o72cth2bs).**

After reading it, I'm sure you'll agree... **We cannot let them down now.**

You can make a big difference in teaching our youngest citizens to be intelligent patriots.

And because we have distributed an astonishing 700,000 pocket-sized copies of the Constitution to schools nationwide, you will make a difference in your community as well.

**But the demand could soon exhaust our budget ...**

...especially because we do all of our work without accepting even ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support. Not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY.

It's generous citizens like **you** --who care about teaching young people America's founding principles of liberty--and who fund our pocket Constitution program and every other educational outreach initiative here.

These national educational outreach programs include teaching anyone wishing to learn with free online courses. Your gift will reach millions of Americans through _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty. And your support will restore excellence to K-12 education by providing thousands of children with a classical education.

You can see how much we need you. So, I have a simple question for you:

**Will you support our successful educational outreach efforts with your best tax-deductible gift?**

**When you do, you 'll reach and teach millions of Americans nationwide on behalf of liberty, including in your state, about the Constitution. Including our youngest Americans.**

You love this country. You know how important it is to educate young minds properly. And today, you can take learning directly to schools in your state and nationwide.

**That 's why I hope you'll give a generous tax-deductible contribution of $15, $25, $35, $50, or even $100 or more at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/give-schoolchildren-the-constitution**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zsur5dhans1qfhj0kmqbb8ah5b9gmmqop7fusrk8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg62o72cth2bs)

I know you share our commitment, and I hope you will join us in our effort. Thank you!

For our youth,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Young minds in classrooms all across America need your help. Critical race theory and woke politics are found nationwide in K-12 classrooms, even in your state. These radical ideologies have pushed K-12 education in America to a crisis point, threatening freedom itself.

Will you support our mission to provide pocket-sized Constitutions to students in your state and advance educational resources that teach the principles of liberty? You will help millions of Americans nationwide--including our youngest Americans. **You can easily give your best gift at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/give-schoolchildren-the-constitution**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zog8l7p87ervk5l5dsrvklp2hlgu54hki5rntcv8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg62o72cth2bs)

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: You and I can’t let them down now
body:
K-12 education in America is at a crisis point.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zgovmin47aopslmjhm59jaklabvf9ancdj96a860_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg66or4cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

K-12 education in America is at a crisis point. And students in classrooms all across this country need your help.

My name is Bill Gray, and I work at Hillsdale College.

**Have you seen how activists and education bureaucrats in our nation have taken over K-12 schools? They are pushing to replace the idea of equal individual rights and replace them with a more destructive idea: unequal rights based on identity.**

**You can see how they do this using critical race theory and other Marxist ideologies.**

**And they 're undoubtedly doing so in K-12 classrooms in your community.**

That's why today, I'm asking you to help us provide pocket Constitutions for young students. These vital founding documents will help them learn about America's founding documents and history--right from the source.

Even a small gift can go a long way:
* [$15 can provide booklets to 75 students](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zpe78kamv8235ooecft0dft47rlokrn5hs44pmhg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg66or4cph2bs),
* [$25 reaches and teaches 125 students](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zttihmcfuos6pgmlmae88ml8ukiv3impii96qs50_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg66or4cph2bs),
* [$35 reaches and teaches 175 students](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zkinf9te0kdpnh4vbse12aliqor8o4sd0bi7ne0o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg66or4cph2bs),
* [$50 helps 250 students](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zaq42ut50pnq9li8o7jlj7kmdn5r54cl721klj4o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg66or4cph2bs).

I'm sure you agree that efforts like this are more important than ever. We need more and more K-12 students reading and understanding the Constitution and Declaration if we're to save America.

It isn't a secret that American civics education--education in American history and government--has been abandoned in far too many of our schools. We've seen how hundreds of thousands of young people are unaware of the importance of the Constitution to liberty. This threatens freedom itself!

Can you help us do something about this knowledge gap? **With your help, we can take action.**

When we send out pocket-sized Constitutions that YOU provide to teachers, principals, and administrators across the country, we make an important promise...

_ To send as many pocket Constitutions as needed so that they can teach their students about our nation's founding principles of liberty!_

You may be encouraged by this...we receive requests for more pocket Constitutions weekly. That's a sign that there is hope for education in America. After all, great teachers know how important it is for their students to receive a proper civics education.

And, when you help, you'll also be helping these students. Most of the high school students who send us letters take a moment to say how excited they were to learn about America's founding documents. **[Here's a copy of one letter from a high school senior named Ava that you can read for yourself](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjrnhufuf0fbgn5o6561kshhv9qnbhfukj08k4h8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg66or4cph2bs).**

After reading it, I'm sure you'll agree... **We cannot let them down now.**

You can make a big difference in teaching our youngest citizens to be intelligent patriots.

And because we have distributed an astonishing 700,000 pocket-sized copies of the Constitution to schools nationwide, you will make a difference in your community as well.

**But the demand could soon exhaust our budget ...**

...especially because we do all of our work without accepting even ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support. Not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY.

It's generous citizens like **you** --who care about teaching young people America's founding principles of liberty--and who fund our pocket Constitution program and every other educational outreach initiative here.

These national educational outreach programs include teaching anyone wishing to learn with free online courses. Your gift will reach millions of Americans through _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College's digest of liberty. And your support will restore excellence to K-12 education by providing thousands of children with a classical education.

You can see how much we need you. So, I have a simple question for you:

**Will you support our successful educational outreach efforts with your best tax-deductible gift?**

**When you do, you 'll reach and teach millions of Americans nationwide on behalf of liberty, including in your state, about the Constitution. Including our youngest Americans.**

You love this country. You know how important it is to educate young minds properly. And today, you can take learning directly to schools in your state and nationwide.

**That 's why I hope you'll give a generous tax-deductible contribution of $15, $25, $35, $50, or even $100 or more at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/give-schoolchildren-the-constitution**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zr5kqut8idndc7gd8vtil8glcfdv03fnust17h18_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg66or4cph2bs)

I know you share our commitment, and I hope you will join us in our effort. Thank you!

For our youth,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Young minds in classrooms all across America need your help. Critical race theory and woke politics are found nationwide in K-12 classrooms, even in your state. These radical ideologies have pushed K-12 education in America to a crisis point, threatening freedom itself.

Will you support our mission to provide pocket-sized Constitutions to students in your state and advance educational resources that teach the principles of liberty? You will help millions of Americans nationwide--including our youngest Americans. **You can easily give your best gift at the secure link below:**

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/give-schoolchildren-the-constitution**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zfvcltla7jh96unad4rvo6qlkq9mk4um9jneuem8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg66or4cph2bs)

name: Sarah DeValkenaere
subject: In prison for saving a life
body:
I wish I could sit down with you face to face instead of writing this e-mail.

Dear Friend,

I wish I could sit down with you face to face instead of writing this e-mail.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zibea7ofg6ag87iupv2o9jeeggaeurmj2p9ilaa8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg61ob0sph2bs)
That's a picture of me and my husband, Eric, so you at least know what we look like.

Eric is a Detective with the Kansas City Police Department.

I wanted to send a picture of us with our three beautiful children - but in this current political climate, I don't feel safe sharing photos of our kids on the Internet.

When I tell you what happened, I think you'll understand. **[And I pray that you'll find it in your heart to help me save my husband.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsba9ltagh3nr80fs3uqlc0561ogs8eeikpuc4l0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg61ob0sph2bs)**

You see, it all started in early December - a few weeks before Christmas.

One of Eric's fellow detectives witnessed two vehicles speeding through the city streets - one was clearly chasing the other - and the police helicopter quickly got involved. A spotter in the helicopter was able to locate the suspect in a red pickup truck... still speeding down city streets.

The driver, 26-year-old Cameron Lamb, was chasing his ex-girlfriend in a stolen truck - weaving across lanes and running through stoplights.

My husband and his partner responded to the call and caught up with the suspect as he attempted to back the stolen truck into a garage.

Both detectives got out of their police vehicles and approached the stolen truck while repeatedly ordering the suspect to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS.

That's when it happened.

**As Eric 's partner approached the driver's side, the suspect reached into his waistband and pulled out a handgun - pointing it directly at the detective.**

**My husband 's police training kicked in.**

He fired four rounds in the direction of the suspect through the truck's front windshield. The truck continued traveling into the garage where it finally came to a stop.

When officers entered, they found the suspect deceased - his arm hanging out the open window with a .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground below.

That night, when Eric returned home, I hugged him and burst into tears. I was so thankful he was safe - and hopeful we could move forward and put this episode behind us.

But it didn't end there.

Several months later, the local prosecutor _charged Eric with MANSLAUGHTER and Armed Criminal Action._

I was in shock.

Then late last year, my husband finally went to trial. The judge ruled against him - and Eric was sentenced to 6 years in prison.

Now you understand why I'm asking for your help.

My husband is an honest man of integrity who followed in his father's law enforcement footsteps. Eric himself is a decorated, 21-year veteran of the Kansas City Police Department.

He's a role model in our community - a Little League baseball coach, a tireless volunteer, and a loving husband and father.

My husband is a hero.

But it didn't matter to the prosecutor that the suspect recklessly swerved a stolen truck through city streets... that he was violent toward his ex-girlfriend and endangered the lives of her two children... that he pointed a stolen gun directly at a police officer.

For serving our community for over 20 years - and risking his life - my has been shipped to an out-of-state prison.

And since the Missouri Supreme Court recently declined to take up Eric's case, that's where he'll stay for the next six years unless he receives a pardon from the Governor of Missouri. He'll miss our wedding anniversaries, our children's birthdays, their graduations(?), and our home will be left without the father and husband we love.

Even if Eric's good name is eventually cleared, just thinking about the cost of his defense and now our efforts to get him pardoned is overwhelming...

... but thank God we got a call from Jason Johnson, President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

If you've ever heard of LELDF you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly accused police officers like Eric.

LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments.

And with the thought of trying to suddenly raise our three children alone - I was certainly at one of the lowest moments of my life.

Not only did the LELDF board decide to help provide Eric with the best possible legal defense, but now they're helping us launch a nationwide petition campaign urging Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric.

But as a non-profit organization, they depend solely on generous gifts from folks like you to defend officers like Eric.

I truly believe God is using Jason and the LELDF to answer our prayers.

That's because my husband and I are not wealthy people. I'm a kindergarten teacher and Eric is a career cop.

So I must ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone.

**Will you donate[$35 or any amount to LELDF today to help save my husband?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zthalcm4uedodbbvi6r7httu34udrgamn64hn34g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg61ob0sph2bs)**

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I am so scared for Eric and I will do whatever I can for him - and for our children.

**[So I pray you'll find it in your heart today to make a tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100 or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z302iln8he26roi0caap6qdpv1blhk62nhla61a8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg61ob0sph2bs)**

Eric and I - and our three kids - are counting on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you to help bring Eric home where he belongs.

No matter what you're able to give today, please pray for us. Thank you in advance for your support.

Sincerely,

Sarah DeValkenaere

P.S. The Missouri Supreme Court has declined to take Eric's case. Now a pardon is one of the last remaining options to bring Eric home. We're feverishly trying to raise the money to pay for a massive petition drive urging the Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric. I know my husband is innocent. But it's so hard to be a cop these days. The 'defund the police' movement has wiped out the support officers like Eric need to do their jobs.

And dozens of prosecutors across the country have made it a priority to try and lock up as many cops as they can. Even if they followed their training or defended themselves in the line of duty. The brave men and women in blue need to know that someone... anyone still has their back.

**[That's why I sincerely hope you'll help me get justice for Eric - and our entire family - by making a tax-deductible gift of any amount to the LELDF today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z12spsrg16c806oo78ssnsfo3064o321is2khmv8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30stg61ob0sph2bs)**

Thank you, and God bless!
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

| | Dear Fellow American,

K-12 education in America is at a crisis point. And students in classrooms all across this country need your help.

My name is Bill Gray, and I work at Hillsdale College.

**Have you seen how activists and education bureaucrats in our nation have taken over K-12 schools? They are pushing to replace the idea of equal individual rights and replace them with a more destructive idea: unequal rights based on identity.**

**You can see how they do this using critical race theory and other Marxist ideologies.**

**And they 're undoubtedly doing so in K-12 classrooms in your community.**

## Warning Labels Proposed for Social Media
U.S. Surgeon General Vivek Murthy, a father of two, urged Congress [to mandate tobacco-style warning](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8Gb1jwcIAMDJUqb-lSVR0tbB6YCkMEJFH-vkrnzqeTTvd9WS42ppjDhz3QdF8Wu_V4x0VSrilMyzQ44xEBxYCGK64VP2l-GnbDJSplwa8KJuE9kyilR7VKDmexbuchGmAwMck1OwMHPorJceX06gTzAIqRiaGLvdTxp8Tcd_TpWe5Yx60cQzJ779dGxBuBmcBs1y3jo42hvDCB-euTwNxuNWDJNGDGahPdbEqN7mhT3-nD1hxzaLSVLdpED3TR0me55YD1JfdSn0TM0RHxzjkTWmsJQzXu-ogpxSYVmVg4bEx_Sf3_QXcDvwEAAP__KmpoBw) labels on social media platforms to safeguard young people's mental health. In a Monday op-ed, Murthy highlighted the urgent [youth mental health crisis](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1uhTAMQOGnCVtQ7ISfO2Towna7dkSGGK6rQFBIQX37qp07n-FI38dzfJJE2dd32tiXJY00F7l4bDX0Gt3oquAXZmRbsYcO-g6aHprq5RukR-8mahAA5r4JxMu0WNdaMO6BVIlHg8600JsHAkJtXYAu9FOwZkHsjHKGg5SU688ke3nxEr_Txbme01ZF_yrlOJV9UzgoHO77ru-rbGB_s8KBcpE5ssLh_Morp12vvHOmqG_Ku-yrjjRx1GeahaLeOAhpOo5T4dAC2M44qLIPxy0xytl2ypl1I4l_-_I_xuXxJwAA___eimDV), naming social media as a significant contributor to anxiety and depression. He advised [delaying kids' social media access](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8Gb1jwcIAMDJUqb-lSVR0tbB6YCkMEJFH-vkrnzqeTTvd9WS42ppjDhz3QdF8Wu_V4x0VSrilMyzQ44xEBxYCGK64VP2l-GnbDJSplwa8KJuE9kyilR7VKDmexbuchGmAwMck1OwMHPorJceX06gTzAIqRiaGLvdTxp8Tcd_TpWe5Yx60cQzJ779dGxBuBmcBs1y3jo42hvDCB-euTwNxuNWDJNGDGahPdbEqN7mhT3-nD1hxzaLSVLdpED3TR0me55YD1JfdSn0TM0RHxzjkTWmsJQzXu-ogpxSYVmVg4bEx_Sf3_QXcDvwEAAP__KmpoBw) until after middle school and recommended phone-free zones for classrooms, meals, and gatherings to safeguard sleep, real-life connections, and mental health. Studies show teens average 3.5 hours of daily social media use, many exceeding 7 hours, with those ages 12-15 spending over 3 hours having double the rate of depression and anxiety.
## Aarhus, Denmark Named Happiest City
Aarhus, Denmark has been named the happiest city in the world for 2024, according to the Happy City Index, ranked by researchers from the Institute for Quality of Life. [See the full rankings here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszz1uhDAQQOHT2B2r8dgYb-EiDd2mTYkMM14mMj9iLRJuHyV1-qcnfR-P4ZGkyPp8TwvHmrchTVVOHnxjQoNucJpiZka2mqPpTOhMG0yr5zhloDb7fAdOfiLnbLKOLUHwMPqRtEQEdOBNgDsaNDfryHQURrKQETtQDpikbsftc5O1zpzLtZ183KZt0SXOte4vZd8U9gr7Oe371UxSr0ZW4u_fSGGvj0j7l5QiL98pB88lSfkb1P85Z8SfAAAA__8jAkxc). The research firm analyzed data on citizenship, governance, environment, economy, and mobility collected from 250 international cities with at least 300,000 residents. The cities were then divided into three groups: gold, silver and bronze. The 17 highest-scoring cities all fell in Europe, specifically within Denmark, Switzerland, Germany, Netherlands, Finland, the United Kingdom, Sweden, Austria, and Iceland. [The only U.S. city](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO4yAQgOGngY4IxtiQguIad7n2SovAEOaEjQUo1r79Kltv_RW_9P97bA9PhY7XX7-jG6luPgx647YIZQXoTfPoEiLgxNEpo6xRs1Uzz84GkMYkCMtktZnNnO4pGmtMeAYfnpGTAwlaLsrKOyhQt0lHZaJ9xkkmACOZlhhp1Hb7X-kYGVP5qm9st1B3Xlwe4-xs-sNgZbCOjJlK-RiDNdcdD7w6g1Ub0FYrMTJ2FEqKQIOwC99Q-L0er4-Iq7YSu8j-PAn7EAdeouFZ22Cw8ubieVEp1BfDtHztnn5KfPz-5O3gOwAA___BZ2Pu) to make it into the European dominated gold group was Minneapolis, Minnesota. In total, 10 U.S. cities landed on The Happy City Index. Ranked among the 'silver' cities were Boston; Baltimore; and the District of Columbia. Bronze cities were San Francisco; Salt Lake City; Madison, Wisconsin; Pittsburgh; Rochester, Minnesota; and Portland, Oregon.

| | Dear Fellow American,

K-12 education in America is at a crisis point. And students in classrooms all across this country need your help.

My name is Bill Gray, and I work at Hillsdale College.

**Have you seen how activists and education bureaucrats in our nation have taken over K-12 schools? They are pushing to replace the idea of equal individual rights and replace them with a more destructive idea: unequal rights based on identity.**

**You can see how they do this using critical race theory and other Marxist ideologies.**

**And they 're undoubtedly doing so in K-12 classrooms in your community.**

That's why today, I'm asking you to help us provide pocket Constitutions for young students. These vital founding documents will help them learn about America's founding documents and history--right from the source.

Even a small gift can go a long way:
* [$15 can provide booklets to 75 students](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82dab0643c7d4ec893246625fe0228dd&_e=WU-MemcfkcnB8CiLTjSJOkAyga9qAplfqJSw32xPthpXx6u740ouRPI2YhPEZ0D8LlGMpYKqKQlAXmexqRTsM9z5hvHVbdRmIeyFoYo4ROG40DVx2KiHhnudOhhjfWnqJrr4MjZGVqNi6tGq8vVfIgwNKnr8Q3k34w9IYX6kyS-DQkPxOQ3_2wBQs2SrajMzC61B505smm2G_h7Sl2urzXMCH7pP3a3y2m6QLDMYYL1oSiquVZczPjMRBJhkdmi2lGJX-_SH5umzOild-KnPdTtGx9t1Nv-GCSVGbZjtVHmr_gCW4g4whNyRD53_bDanhOnsc4itUTsRMKNJwBhBEdKA9d61DhRn4NogriHUi5pYs1bBJgkqw5Ozqqvn-9vsF-P8S1dUFR7jRl-PqyKI-ZRlNw7R9tD75deebBD3CROVINecu35SVHbPWTkuWlTt5P9ayrdSUMLP76lOgbxz7g%3D%3D),

* [$50 helps 250 students](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82dab0643c7d4ec893246625fe0228dd&_e=WU-MemcfkcnB8CiLTjSJOkAyga9qAplfqJSw32xPthpXx6u740ouRPI2YhPEZ0D8LlGMpYKqKQlAXmexqRTsM9z5hvHVbdRmIeyFoYo4ROG40DVx2KiHhnudOhhjfWnqJrr4MjZGVqNi6tGq8vVfIgwNKnr8Q3k34w9IYX6kyS-DQkPxOQ3_2wBQs2SrajMzC61B505smm2G_h7Sl2urzXMCH7pP3a3y2m6QLDMYYL1oSiquVZczPjMRBJhkdmi2lGJX-_SH5umzOild-KnPdTtGx9t1Nv-GCSVGbZjtVHlkdmSAaU_Tf42B7h7MfeJun_-8lgwY9BvDmqfZruy3nkp4ODFXlHgWCcFx9uWKiRYut0mf3hhnUAX5mjbrK5zU_9sh2rw55BtCIP2F6pSIErb3AwRfSnYfqJ08kFBltOWw1hFzhdOgFRR1Q6GmxFX4QwPlRpi7VT_sm0HnZBuIBQ%3D%3D).

I'm sure you agree that efforts like this are more important than ever. We need more and more K-12 students reading and understanding the Constitution and Declaration if we're to save America.

It isn't a secret that American civics education--education in American history and government--has been abandoned in far too many of our schools. We've seen how hundreds of thousands of young people are unaware of the importance of the Constitution to liberty. This threatens freedom itself!

Can you help us do something about this knowledge gap? **With your help, we can take action.**

When we send out pocket-sized Constitutions that YOU provide to teachers, principals, and administrators across the country, we make an important promise...

_ To send as many pocket Constitutions as needed so that they can teach their students about our nation's founding principles of liberty!_

You may be encouraged by this...we receive requests for more pocket Constitutions weekly. That's a sign that there is hope for education in America. After all, great teachers know how important it is for their students to receive a proper civics education.

And, when you help, you'll also be helping these students. Most of the high school students who send us letters take a moment to say how excited they were to learn about America's founding documents. **[Here's a copy of one letter from a high school senior named Ava that you can read for yourself](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=82dab0643c7d4ec893246625fe0228dd&_e=WU-MemcfkcnB8CiLTjSJOkAyga9qAplfqJSw32xPthpXx6u740ouRPI2YhPEZ0D8LlGMpYKqKQlAXmexqRTsM9z5hvHVbdRmIeyFoYo4ROG40DVx2KiHhnudOhhjfWnqJrr4MjZGVqNi6tGq8vVfIgwNKnr8Q3k34w9IYX6kyS-DQkPxOQ3_2wBQs2SrajMzC61B505smm2G_h7Sl2urzXMCH7pP3a3y2m6QLDMYYL1oSiquVZczPjMRBJhkdmi2lGJX-_SH5umzOild-KnPdTtGx9t1Nv-GCSVGbZjtVHkkaWXJ548_nqEH4R4ZowjzS8VjNpA9AYNtzXGcVRja2MIvPf2Sm10CWNYy9lKoFiee2Z0YjrVZyWs0voCrwlpZcNpqzhH7G9ZCTSHahAwicPkOrMe40dUXgAiH0K0DPP9Cim6udWgetuCLd1qGAEsFBiLTB3XrAMvO5Xyz-re63g%3D%3D).**

After reading it, I'm sure you'll agree... **We cannot let them down now.**

You can make a big difference in teaching our youngest citizens to be intelligent patriots.

And because we have distributed an astonishing 700,000 pocket-sized copies of the Constitution to schools nationwide, you will make a difference in your community as well.

**But the demand could soon exhaust our budget ...**

...especially because we do all of our work without accepting even ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer support. Not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY.

It's generous citizens like **you** --who care about teaching young people America's founding principles of liberty--and who fund our pocket Constitution program and every other educational outreach initiative here.

body:
No images? [Click here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-e-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-q/) This week, our campaign launched a new radio ad highlighting my mission to work across the aisle to deliver real policy solutions based on independence, compassion, and commonsense for the families of the 10th Congressional District. I will bring new leadership to Washington and work to address the issues that are facing our families: inflation, public safety, and immigration reform. [Listen To 'New Leadership' Radio Ad](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-r/) Team Carris,

The 10th Congressional District has a long history of being represented by thoughtful independent leaders, who go to Washington and deliver for our families. Unfortunately, for nearly 10 years, Brad Schneider hasn't delivered for our families because he chooses to vote with party leaders, like Nancy Pelosi, [almost 100% of the time](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-y/), putting partisan politics ahead of our communities. It's time we get back to the legacy of thoughtful independent leadership.**While many want to write off our District, recent polling shows that****we can win this election and flip this District**. Our neighbors and friends are unhappy. By a 2-to-1 margin, voters think the country is on the wrong track and **voters overwhelmingly (85%) disapprove of the job Congress is doing**. Brad Schneider's out-of-touch, partisan politics has left many voters feeling defeated. **Consider that in 10 years, Brad Schneider has passed zero bills into law**. He has been quoted on the record saying he won't work across the aisle and has consistently voted in favor of massive spending bills while opposing measures to address federal debt and deficits, directly contributing to rising inflation. Schneider has also supported policies making it easier to sue police officers, voted against giving cop killers the death penalty, and voted against classifying fentanyl-related substances as Schedule 1 narcotics. These are just a few examples of his lack of leadership.Our District is tired of this nonsense. **Our campaign 's core messages are resonating with a variety of groups of voters - regardless of partisan affiliation - providing opportunities for new Republican votes**.We know that a dynamic, well-funded candidate can win in November but **we need your help to make sure that our core messages reach all 10th District residents** \- especially young people, women, seniors, and voters in underrepresented areas. **This outreach takes significant financial resources**. Our campaign is powered by everyday citizens, not special interests. **Your contribution ensures that our movement remains people-powered and that we can bring real, meaningful change to Congress.** We know that now more than ever, every dollar is going towards supporting your families. We want you to know that when you give to Carris for Congress, your donation is carefully and judiciously spent on:
* **Outreach and Engagement** : Funds are used to organize community events and canvassing efforts to engage directly with voters and hear their concerns.
* **Campaign Materials** : Donations help produce informative literature, yard signs, and other materials to spread our message far and wide.
* **Advertising** : Your support allows us to run effective digital, radio, and television ads to ensure our vision and policies are known to all.

By donating to our campaign, **you are not just supporting a candidate - you are investing in a movement for change**. In 2024, we have the chance to send a real message to Washington, that it's time to work for American families.**I ask everyone to get off the sidelines and join us by donating to our campaign today**. Even the smallest contribution makes a difference on the road to election day. [Click to Donate Here Today](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-j/) Thank you for your support, your time, and your efforts. I am proud to be a 10th District resident and to fight for all of you. Jim Carris
Candidate for Congress **Upcoming Events - Meet Jim!** Please join Jim on **Tuesday, June 26** at [Prairie House Tavern](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-t/) in Buffalo Grove for an opportunity to learn more about his campaign for U.S. Congress in Illinois' 10th District! [Click Here to Register for June 26](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-i/) **Flag Day - June 14, 2024** June 14th was Flag Day! On June 14, 1777, the Continental Congress approved the design of our national flag. On June 14th, every year since the early 1900s, Americans commemorate our flag today by displaying it proudly in places like their homes, during public celebrations, and during patriotic observances.Fun Fact: Did you know that the flag's design is credited to Francis Hopkinson, who also designed the Great Seal and first coin of the United States? **On the Road in #IL10** 🇺🇸 **Commemorating the Battle of Midway at the Great Lakes Naval Station**
My daughter and I had the privilege of attending the Great Lakes Naval Station (NSGL) Battle of Midway Commemoration at the National Museum of the Sailor! On the 81st anniversary of the Battle, we listened to Commanding Officer Yargosz share a detailed overview of the tactical plans behind the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps' success in the Pacific alongside scores of men and women in uniform stationed at NSGL. We stayed afterwards to explore the Museum and I highly recommend stopping by with your families! 🇺🇸 **Enjoying Coffee and Conversation in Winnetka**
I joined several wonderful women and individuals in Winnetka for a women's event. We discussed critical issues like gun safety, the future of the economy, reproductive rights, and the future of political discourse. I was honored with an introduction by my incredible oldest daughter, Christina. Thank you to everyone who attended and I look forward to seeing more constituents at future events around the District. 🇺🇸 **Learning About the Fentanyl Crisis in Lake County**
My Deputy Campaign Manager and I attended a Naloxone (Narcan) Training organized by Nicasa Behavioral Health Services and Omni Youth Services and not only do we feel more prepared to help residents of our District in an emergency, but we discussed the startling facts behind fentanyl and opioid use in Lake County. In 2023, the Lake County Coroner's Office investigated 135 drug overdose deaths - 112 attributable to opioids and 97 of which contained fentanyl. 🇺🇸 **Riding in Support of Our Law Enforcement**
What a fun Saturday spent riding between Lake Bluff, Gurnee, Grayslake, and Libertyville with Lakeshore Harley Davidson, Motorcycle Safety Lawyers, and Custom Cycle Rescue Chicago and Angeles Del Silencio LEMC for the first annual Ride for Resilience to support the Chicago Police Memorial Foundation and fight the stigma surrounding mental health issues. 🇺🇸 **Sharing My Hometown Pride with IL10**
It was great to be back home in Lincolnshire this week! I always love visiting my hometown. We had a great evening talking to residents from around the District about issues important to them including taxes and fiscal responsibility, national security, and public safety. It's clear that our neighbors in #IL10 want change and need a representative that will fight for common sense and compassionate policies to support their families and that's my mission when I get to Washington. 🇺🇸 **Raising Awareness with Families in Waukegan**
I attended the Boys and Girls Club of Lake County Aim for Peace: Gun Violence Awareness Day in Waukegan and had the honor of hearing from heartbroken families whose lives have been impacted by gun violence. I had the pleasure of speaking with a Waukegan police officer who shared some of the challenges that law enforcement in the area have with enforcing policies and ensuring that weapons are not making their way in the hands of criminals. Another highlight for me was enjoying the safe community space with some of our District kids. We played basketball and enjoyed the gym with their families! Are you interested in hosting a meet and greet for Team Carris or inviting Jim to your event? Email us at info@carrisforcongress.com! **Join Team Carris** We need your help! Join our team to make a difference by attending events, connecting with neighbors and constituents around the District, and sharing information with your network. [Click Here to Sign Up to Volunteer](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-d/) **Request a Yard Sign**
Spread the word about Team Carris in your neighborhood! If you would like one of our team members to drop of a sign(s), please fill out the form below by clicking the button! [Click Here to Request a Sign](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-h/) **Check Out Our Summer Internship Opportunities**
Calling all students and recent grads! Are you looking to join a dynamic team of volunteers this summer to work on a congressional campaign? Apply today to join Team Carris for a summer internship. As a Team Carris Intern, you will get experience working on a congressional campaign and learn the inner-workings of the campaign world. The program is open to high school students, college students, and recent graduates - no prior campaign experience is required. [Click Here to Apply](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-k/) **Follow Carris for Congress on Social Media** **Post of the Week:**
We love when you tag us in your posts and send us photos from the campaign trail! We shared this image from fellow candidate, Ben Grum for Lake County Board, who stopped to shout out the campaign during a recent Lake County Juvenile Officers Association Golf Outing. Make sure to tag us or use the hashtag #carrisforcongress when you post! Do you want to stay in touch and follow Jim throughout the 10th District? Make sure to follow us on social media to learn about Jim's platform and to get to know the District through his experience meeting local residents, supporting small businesses and local organizations, and learning about how #IL10 families really want their representative to vote in Washington. **Click Below to Follow** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-n/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-p/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-x/)
**Share with Your Friends!**
We also need your help! You can download the Social Media Toolkit below to share your support with your network on your favorite social media channels. Create a post today and don't forget to tag us and use #carrisforcongress. We will share our favorite posts! [Click Here to Download](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-m/) **Support Carris for Congress** Jim is on a mission to bring independence, compassion, and common sense to Washington. Your continued financial support will help us reach more voters through our grassroots organizing efforts. Together, we can secure a win for Illinois and for our country by sending Jim to our nation's capital! [Give Today](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ehhiity-tlidtddjku-c/) | Paid for by Carris for Congress . . name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Do we have to email every day?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1548%2E135344%2EuJwuYu)

Friends -
From time-to-time, I get asked, "Elissa, do you have to send these fundraising emails every single day? It gets to be pretty overwhelming."
Let me start by saying... I get it. 100%. I open my inbox and am getting emails from campaigns I care about, ones I've never heard of, and everything in between. My inbox is a mess.
Unfortunately, the answer is yes. We do have to send these emails this often. Let me pull back the curtain on why that is:
First, like any good campaign, we start with a goal. We think we know how much we need to raise, and spend, and by when, in order to win this race. We have a fairly good handle on that.
Then we have to raise that money by the time we need it in-hand. Standard practice for any campaign, any business, or any family that has a budget.
Then we need to figure out where that money comes from. Some of it comes from me calling donors and asking for contributions. Some from events. Some of it comes in without me even asking. And a very large bucket is emails like this one.
Now, if I could send one email and reach our email goal, believe me I would do that. No doubt. But the truth is, that's far from the case.
At this point in the campaign, because of past response rates, we know how many emails we have to send in order to raise what we need to meet our goals. That's how many emails we'll send: no more, no less.
And then when someone donates, they are removed from fundraising solicitations for a period of time.
I am hoping today will be a day you choose to give. To help us reach our goals before this FEC deadline ends. What do you say?
[**Can you use this link to contribute $3 to my campaign for Senate in Michigan? We need your help to reach our very real fundraising goals before our FEC deadline ends. body:
The upcoming months; "they" all know about Nebraska

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/c80f5ffcb31c/n41kepo7ku-12700479?e=25844e23a8)
https://ne.gop/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=ac2521dbb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-ac2521dbb5-21732365

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
Proverbs 23:24 The father of godly children has cause for joy. What a pleasure to have children who are wise.
Happy (belated) Father's Day to all and I hope every day is a blessed day with your family. I lost my father in 2014 to cancer, but I faithfully believe I will see him again. I spend every moment of my life faithfully fighting for the future of my five children.
------------------------------------------------------------
What a whirlwind past 30 days. Over the last month, the amount of political activity has just been non-stop. From the state Primary to our Republican State Convention, planning for the National Convention in Milwaukee, campaigns having Days of Action, parade season, county meetings, fundraisers, door knocking, training sessions and tons of networking across the state and nationally.
Then add to that the national news from every angle of border chaos to inflation, election fraud coming to light everywhere, President Trump's sham NY trial, and the year is not even half over.
What is daunting for the average American...what is disconcerting for the hard-working Nebraskans...what keeps me driven to do more and more to protect my family and community...is...
We do not know the ENTIRETY of reality.
We do not know the detailed TRUTH of what is really transpiring to this country.
We do not have LIGHT on all the information so we can prepare or protect or defend or even move forward with certainty on what is to come.
We see a lot of the pieces, we can grasp some of it in real time...but many different entities are fighting for power, control, money, and WE, THE PEOPLE, are in the middle of all this. Which makes one so frustrated as to what do WE do about it.
What I do know is this...our form of elected representation has been warped to become a self-serving and self-contained money and power apparatus. I want to be positive and supportive because I do believe we are very fortunate in Nebraska to have some caring and driven elected officials, leaders who love to see Nebraska at it's finest and truly want to help people live the Good Life.
But there is a circling of the wagons at the Federal level, because they fear one man's influence and fortitude.
They don't fear his money.
They don't fear his accomplishments.
They fear his popularity with a vast majority of Americans and his resolve for reckoning will expose their ineffectiveness.
Because he figured out that the HIGHEST commodity to achieve political success was NOT money for palm cards, and mailers, and yard signs, and t.v./radio ad buys...the most IMPORTANT commodity in politics has, and will always be...PEOPLE.
The politicians of the past decades have been living in an archaic political culture perpetuated by campaign consultants who do NOT have to stay true to any party platform. They swear no oath of allegiance or loyalty to the Republican party membership and purposefully try to erode the very ORGANIZATION of the party if they don't control it. When they control it, they abuse it and the membership. The Democratic Party consultants are no better, but the leaders of the Democratic Party locked down a system to control the "basics" of campaigns through controlling ALL the money.
In the Democratic Party, everyone falls in line with this elaborate matrix of money funnelling, family trusts, 501c3's and c4's, Large donors, candidates, consultants, etc. It's an extensive and effective means of pinpoint targeting of ballots (not votes, be clear on the distinction) and they HAVE to do this because their principles do not match the vast majority of Americans. They assessed the most effective and ONLY way they win is to flood mailing addresses with ballots, manipulate precincts and polling stations, and corrupt the machines that count the ballots. No need to Get-out-the-Vote (GOTV), when you can Harvest the Ballot in urban areas and thus disenfranchise rural areas and voters.
All these consultants use low voter turnout or even fraudulent elections to warp the principles of our party because their only goal is to make MONEY and indicate WINNING is the result of...more money! They say..."SEE, look at the results of the 27% voter turnout and that must be what EVEYONE wants. SEE, it looks like our principles need to be compromised in certain districts or a Republican will lose!" Then they add the fear, guilt, and shame messaging to unassuming Republican voters and say "YOU wouldn't want to be the CAUSE of us LOSING would you?!?"
Wash, rinse, repeat...every election cycle.
It's in EVERY State.
There is NOT an overarching concern for the well being of citizens at the basic human levels such as life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. If there WAS concern, then...life, liberty, and people's pursuit of happiness would not be in jeopardy nationwide and ESPECIALLY in Red states dominated by Republican voters such as Nebraska. There would be no excuses. There would only be extreme ownership of solutions. Integrity of Institutions would not take precedence over the destruction of our country. Fear of "what if the tables were turned and the Democrats had the power?" They DO have the tables turned in some Blue states AND they do EVEYTHING including breaking Integrity of Institutions to keep it! I say, stop worrying about IF the tables will be turned and start FLIPPING some tables to protect the freedoms and rights of Americans!
There is NO sense of urgency for the concerns of the citizens; maybe next year seems to be the motto!
There is NO next year!!
There are special interests concerns.
There are stakeholders concerns.
There are profit and control concerns.
It's an epiphany when you realize that what you believe no one KNOWS about Nebraska...they KNOW about Nebraska.
I was fortunate to spend some time with many Patriot Leaders and Freedom Caucus Congressional leaders in Detriot this weekend. I attended the premier, all-encompassing Republican convention held by Turning Point Action. I was blessed to speak on the main stage and focused the message on Winner-Take-All. If you go to my Twitter/X (@2022NebMaverick) feed you will see a portion of the message. It was such an honor to be there and bring as much national attention to our "flyover" state and the convention was phenomenal. Imagine a convention that blended strong, dedicated leaders that you could actually connect with AND training and seminars on how grassroots can beat the closed-loop system of the Uniparty.
Yeah...everyone in the highest of leadership positions uses the term Uniparty because they know we are witnessing an oligarchy and they aren't just referring to Democrats. They all know.
They all know about the politics of Nebraska over the last several decades. It is shocking how much they know.
However, as much as the Patriot leaders know, there isn't much they can do about it on the individual level. Someone like Congressman Gaetz or Congresswoman MTG is not going to swing in and right any wrongs here. And to be honest, it's not necessarily their job or place. Turning Point/Turning Point Action founder Chalie Kirk made a very profound statement in referencing President Trump. Charlie was so accurate in saying that President Trump is ONE person and one person can only accomplish certain things at their plane of existence. But VOLUMES, masses, multitudes of people UNIFIED on our princples can lead and make a difference, LOCALLY. WE, the people, have to take back our country and even more so...take back the IDENTITY of our party.
We have to show up, know the rules, and achieve an objective.
As much as the Freedom leaders DO know about the political makeup of Nebraska, they didn't know about...you...the grassroots leaders of Nebraska.
They do now. I made sure they knew about you and the amazing hardwork you've accomplished in just two years. I made sure they knew about all your efforts to stand firm on our values, working towards cultivating the new Constitutional and Platform Republicans identity. And the most complimentary response that should encourage and empower you even MORE...they all said.."I wish my state/county GOP's did what you guys did!"
As I've mentioned in other newsletters, we are not alone in this political and archaic bubble. Many Red states are in worse positions because politically things have swung so far to playing "not to lose" that the Democrats seemingly control the Republican party from within and even long standing Republicans are compliant...because that's what "good" Republicans do. What happened to WINNING with our principles?!?
The anti-thesis to all of this corruption is...all of us.
The balance to the political equation that uses money and fear to dictate the messaging and narratives to those who are not as politically savvy...is all of us.
The solution to ineffective governance is the Second House...all of us...the salvation of the State!
Statewide, we have made unprecedented changes to the culture of our Republican Party and other States seek to learn from us. We are leaders in an America First movement. Together, we have been measured, persistent, consistent, and striving to better ourselves everyday in this political landscape.
Together, we have brought STABILITY to this party.
NOW...we must go to the people with our message of Good News. That's what the next FIVE months are about and then even beyond November 5th. We must not stop, because we have major municipality races in 2025 for Omaha and Lincoln, and we have to ready for 2026 Statewide races.
WE...MUST...CONNECT...TO...THE PEOPLE. At their doors. MISSION CRITICAL, door knocking and then INVITING them to a GOP meeting.
DONATE (https://ne.gop/donate/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=ac2521dbb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-ac2521dbb5-21732365) to the NEGOP. DONATE to your local GOP.
https://ne.gop/45in45/?utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=ac2521dbb5-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-ac2521dbb5-21732365
We will put your dollars to work connecting to more Republican voters state-wide.
We will put your dollars to work defeating Democrats at the local level.

We have plenty of work to do with Legislation Support, support of candidates, connecting to coalition partners, event planning, and discussing the different committee's and groups need to be successful in 2024!
The truth shall set us free.
Blessings,
–Chairman Underwood
