[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97496671312846fea97b6ad7fccdf70c&_e=Dnm15JhSneD3IKcDp8VmTFgH34m5n-cVc2eVvwVUmA29J135Jr4UIJ30ksMQQFUJgmoCdyRrERSuqW3mO3mqY08ULFC63esdwyTexDVbFQ9UwhacT9h71YDWMc3BmZhzWP3YLBFA9dKtQNw1flUmPGz1KchYmnk5Bb-qk2H9zgQpz4ErmjZQTZWfI_x9zEWbuv2Bq7-9PxeNrjyWKTrpgucsallSwU2Lw00aaMfGUESk4czF1ZHxyzOHNRBpHt308dVAGbaLWHHBt9efclOo4ccun7xYb_ecyTQEY-rqmYH35fIb6vG0ugudA8LJSpBItrJWjWc82yJYUes25KDRL8i1jZR3tzXcomTOSeCPKUN4lUhnufPdvtgY0BFiHcmZ6Pz50GEVe19RN5K8ZDus7SXUCXZbuEcXyFqDDy6e1f8%3D) Dear Fellow American, Thanks for opening my email. I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97496671312846fea97b6ad7fccdf70c&_e=Dnm15JhSneD3IKcDp8VmTFgH34m5n-cVc2eVvwVUmA29J135Jr4UIJ30ksMQQFUJgmoCdyRrERSuqW3mO3mqY08ULFC63esdwyTexDVbFQ9UwhacT9h71YDWMc3BmZhzWP3YLBFA9dKtQNw1flUmPGz1KchYmnk5Bb-qk2H9zgQpz4ErmjZQTZWfI_x9zEWbuv2Bq7-9PxeNrjyWKTrpgucsallSwU2Lw00aaMfGUESk4czF1ZHxyzOHNRBpHt308dVAGbaLWHHBt9efclOo4XEGqrfIfPr4pHVnxZzTY0WhN8rfH0vbVQGZ8sbfaOaaFnoaUSYEwVf25BPUGCV-TxVICYyF_FieL_X6ytCvBwwD2AzYRTrfarUQD-7eywRVq9xqHukS8XbO1vuxdRzgTPP-x2VAbUbJTqgaPhgbWTE%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the **Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights**. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. **That 's why we've turned our online course, ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97496671312846fea97b6ad7fccdf70c&_e=Dnm15JhSneD3IKcDp8VmTFgH34m5n-cVc2eVvwVUmA29J135Jr4UIJ30ksMQQFUJgmoCdyRrERSuqW3mO3mqY08ULFC63esdwyTexDVbFQ9UwhacT9h71YDWMc3BmZhzWP3YLBFA9dKtQNw1flUmPGz1KchYmnk5Bb-qk2H9zgQpz4ErmjZQTZWfI_x9zEWbuv2Bq7-9PxeNrjyWKTrpgucsallSwU2Lw00aaMfGUESk4czF1ZHxyzOHNRBpHt308dVAGbaLWHHBt9efclOo4R9-KShhtTn6xPk9Ht_ewnrMWiDQn9Tztt16gCTmUu3ZeTMNklCPv-qTeWa0VO_ojT687p7MVPZnFF2ivZwKGLbkd3bcnWZ3fPj2ta6Q32BuhCOiVRM5uFMCdTa4UfGWpweF_7_eU1g1eDLz7chmB_g%3D) into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy.** **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. We produced this course to restore the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among our young people--essential to restoring free government. You'll be excited to learn that **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," which tells people, especially children, that America is essentially an unjust nation--the opposite of our nation's unifying principles. Today, you can claim a DVD copy of ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97496671312846fea97b6ad7fccdf70c&_e=Dnm15JhSneD3IKcDp8VmTFgH34m5n-cVc2eVvwVUmA29J135Jr4UIJ30ksMQQFUJgmoCdyRrERSuqW3mO3mqY08ULFC63esdwyTexDVbFQ9UwhacT9h71YDWMc3BmZhzWP3YLBFA9dKtQNw1flUmPGz1KchYmnk5Bb-qk2H9zgQpz4ErmjZQTZWfI_x9zEWbuv2Bq7-9PxeNrjyWKTrpgucsallSwU2Lw00aaMfGUESk4czF1ZHxyzOHNRBpHt308dVAGbaLWHHBt9efclOo4R5aWwuV-3-GHjGUjtgM4y2nhO_J52nTE6uNa_LZJrDeDdwLBw0qJY4hCr18a1CqIRFvEujnNxLbE1YVswW0OoJEi8aiEFtWSpYaYA64phbkjU0OwhtOgHtnswq_Jxm0XCO3JOIw9tez5NuIpSv7VSY%3D) for your home library or give it as a gift. **Presenting real American history is the surest means of preserving liberty.** Quantities are limited, so reserve your copy today. [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-great-american-story-dvd](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97496671312846fea97b6ad7fccdf70c&_e=Dnm15JhSneD3IKcDp8VmTFgH34m5n-cVc2eVvwVUmA29J135Jr4UIJ30ksMQQFUJgmoCdyRrERSuqW3mO3mqY08ULFC63esdwyTexDVbFQ9UwhacT9h71YDWMc3BmZhzWP3YLBFA9dKtQNw1flUmPGz1KchYmnk5Bb-qk2H9zgQpz4ErmjZQTZWfI_x9zEWbuv2Bq7-9PxeNrjyWKTrpgucsallSwU2Lw00aaMfGUESk4czF1ZHxyzOHNRBpHt308dVAGbaLWHHBt9efclOo4c_jBleHho0pIUxiOiu5KNDevPbqOeW89s6bN8hurDmSZMLQ8JTJma20xMwgKc9mwlSHLIcQjMJ1H0_Me4h6F7zWvJfvBBmWLz1bc5OgO1dW3S66qxA1Hw1xtvKwY2MsWKA4jY9-cEuRIXkmfOIZDAk%3D) Thank you for your partnership with Hillsdale College and for supporting its mission on behalf of liberty. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to The New York Times ' "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. That 's why we've turned our online course, into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy. " The Great American Story: A Land of Hope" presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. We produced this course to restore the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among our young people--essential to restoring free government. You'll be excited to learn that " The Great American Story: A Land of Hope" is a powerful counterweight to The New York Times ' "1619 Project," which tells people, especially children, that America is essentially an unjust nation--the opposite of our nation's unifying principles. Today, you can claim a DVD copy of for your home library or give it as a gift. Presenting real American history is the surest means of preserving liberty. Quantities are limited, so reserve your copy today. Thank you for your partnership with Hillsdale College and for supporting its mission on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College P.S. Despite what The New York Times ' "1619 Project" says, our nation's history is unifying. That's why we've produced a full, unbiased account of America's past with " The Great American Story: A Land of Hope," now available on DVD. You can receive your copy with your generous tax-deductible gift of $100 or more using this secure link: Act today because quantities are limited! Thank you so much for helping us promote intelligent patriotism--especially among younger Americans. | .

body:
No images? [Click here](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-e-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-q/) This week, our campaign launched a new radio ad highlighting my mission to work across the aisle to deliver real policy solutions based on independence, compassion, and commonsense for the families of the 10th Congressional District. I will bring new leadership to Washington and work to address the issues that are facing our families: inflation, public safety, and immigration reform. [Listen To 'New Leadership' Radio Ad](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-r/) Team Carris,

The 10th Congressional District has a long history of being represented by thoughtful independent leaders, who go to Washington and deliver for our families. Unfortunately, for nearly 10 years, Brad Schneider hasn't delivered for our families because he chooses to vote with party leaders, like Nancy Pelosi, [almost 100% of the time](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-y/), putting partisan politics ahead of our communities. It's time we get back to the legacy of thoughtful independent leadership.**While many want to write off our District, recent polling shows that****we can win this election and flip this District**. Our neighbors and friends are unhappy. By a 2-to-1 margin, voters think the country is on the wrong track and **voters overwhelmingly (85%) disapprove of the job Congress is doing**. Brad Schneider's out-of-touch, partisan politics has left many voters feeling defeated. **Consider that in 10 years, Brad Schneider has passed zero bills into law**. He has been quoted on the record saying he won't work across the aisle and has consistently voted in favor of massive spending bills while opposing measures to address federal debt and deficits, directly contributing to rising inflation. Schneider has also supported policies making it easier to sue police officers, voted against giving cop killers the death penalty, and voted against classifying fentanyl-related substances as Schedule 1 narcotics. These are just a few examples of his lack of leadership.Our District is tired of this nonsense. **Our campaign 's core messages are resonating with a variety of groups of voters - regardless of partisan affiliation - providing opportunities for new Republican votes**.We know that a dynamic, well-funded candidate can win in November but **we need your help to make sure that our core messages reach all 10th District residents** \- especially young people, women, seniors, and voters in underrepresented areas. **This outreach takes significant financial resources**. Our campaign is powered by everyday citizens, not special interests. **Your contribution ensures that our movement remains people-powered and that we can bring real, meaningful change to Congress.** We know that now more than ever, every dollar is going towards supporting your families. We want you to know that when you give to Carris for Congress, your donation is carefully and judiciously spent on:
* **Outreach and Engagement** : Funds are used to organize community events and canvassing efforts to engage directly with voters and hear their concerns.
* **Campaign Materials** : Donations help produce informative literature, yard signs, and other materials to spread our message far and wide.
* **Advertising** : Your support allows us to run effective digital, radio, and television ads to ensure our vision and policies are known to all.

By donating to our campaign, **you are not just supporting a candidate - you are investing in a movement for change**. In 2024, we have the chance to send a real message to Washington, that it's time to work for American families.**I ask everyone to get off the sidelines and join us by donating to our campaign today**. Even the smallest contribution makes a difference on the road to election day. [Click to Donate Here Today](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-j/) Thank you for your support, your time, and your efforts. I am proud to be a 10th District resident and to fight for all of you. Jim Carris
Candidate for Congress **Upcoming Events - Meet Jim!** Please join Jim on **Wednesday, June 26** at [Prairie House Tavern](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-t/) in Buffalo Grove for an opportunity to learn more about his campaign for U.S. Congress in Illinois' 10th District! [Click Here to Register for June 26](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-i/) **Flag Day - June 14, 2024** June 14th was Flag Day! On June 14, 1777, the Continental Congress approved the design of our national flag. On June 14th, every year since the early 1900s, Americans commemorate our flag today by displaying it proudly in places like their homes, during public celebrations, and during patriotic observances.Fun Fact: Did you know that the flag's design is credited to Francis Hopkinson, who also designed the Great Seal and first coin of the United States? **On the Road in #IL10** 🇺🇸 **Commemorating the Battle of Midway at the Great Lakes Naval Station**
My daughter and I had the privilege of attending the Great Lakes Naval Station (NSGL) Battle of Midway Commemoration at the National Museum of the Sailor! On the 81st anniversary of the Battle, we listened to Commanding Officer Yargosz share a detailed overview of the tactical plans behind the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps' success in the Pacific alongside scores of men and women in uniform stationed at NSGL. We stayed afterwards to explore the Museum and I highly recommend stopping by with your families! 🇺🇸 **Enjoying Coffee and Conversation in Winnetka**
I joined several wonderful women and individuals in Winnetka for a women's event. We discussed critical issues like gun safety, the future of the economy, reproductive rights, and the future of political discourse. I was honored with an introduction by my incredible oldest daughter, Christina. Thank you to everyone who attended and I look forward to seeing more constituents at future events around the District. 🇺🇸 **Learning About the Fentanyl Crisis in Lake County**
My Deputy Campaign Manager and I attended a Naloxone (Narcan) Training organized by Nicasa Behavioral Health Services and Omni Youth Services and not only do we feel more prepared to help residents of our District in an emergency, but we discussed the startling facts behind fentanyl and opioid use in Lake County. In 2023, the Lake County Coroner's Office investigated 135 drug overdose deaths - 112 attributable to opioids and 97 of which contained fentanyl. 🇺🇸 **Riding in Support of Our Law Enforcement**
What a fun Saturday spent riding between Lake Bluff, Gurnee, Grayslake, and Libertyville with Lakeshore Harley Davidson, Motorcycle Safety Lawyers, and Custom Cycle Rescue Chicago and Angeles Del Silencio LEMC for the first annual Ride for Resilience to support the Chicago Police Memorial Foundation and fight the stigma surrounding mental health issues. 🇺🇸 **Sharing My Hometown Pride with IL10**
It was great to be back home in Lincolnshire this week! I always love visiting my hometown. We had a great evening talking to residents from around the District about issues important to them including taxes and fiscal responsibility, national security, and public safety. It's clear that our neighbors in #IL10 want change and need a representative that will fight for common sense and compassionate policies to support their families and that's my mission when I get to Washington. 🇺🇸 **Raising Awareness with Families in Waukegan**
I attended the Boys and Girls Club of Lake County Aim for Peace: Gun Violence Awareness Day in Waukegan and had the honor of hearing from heartbroken families whose lives have been impacted by gun violence. I had the pleasure of speaking with a Waukegan police officer who shared some of the challenges that law enforcement in the area have with enforcing policies and ensuring that weapons are not making their way in the hands of criminals. Another highlight for me was enjoying the safe community space with some of our District kids. We played basketball and enjoyed the gym with their families! Are you interested in hosting a meet and greet for Team Carris or inviting Jim to your event? Email us at info@carrisforcongress.com! **Join Team Carris** We need your help! Join our team to make a difference by attending events, connecting with neighbors and constituents around the District, and sharing information with your network. [Click Here to Sign Up to Volunteer](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-d/) **Request a Yard Sign**
Spread the word about Team Carris in your neighborhood! If you would like one of our team members to drop of a sign(s), please fill out the form below by clicking the button! [Click Here to Request a Sign](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-h/) **Check Out Our Summer Internship Opportunities**
Calling all students and recent grads! Are you looking to join a dynamic team of volunteers this summer to work on a congressional campaign? Apply today to join Team Carris for a summer internship. As a Team Carris Intern, you will get experience working on a congressional campaign and learn the inner-workings of the campaign world. The program is open to high school students, college students, and recent graduates - no prior campaign experience is required. [Click Here to Apply](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-k/) **Follow Carris for Congress on Social Media** **Post of the Week:**
We love when you tag us in your posts and send us photos from the campaign trail! We shared this image from fellow candidate, Ben Grum for Lake County Board, who stopped to shout out the campaign during a recent Lake County Juvenile Officers Association Golf Outing. Make sure to tag us or use the hashtag #carrisforcongress when you post! Do you want to stay in touch and follow Jim throughout the 10th District? Make sure to follow us on social media to learn about Jim's platform and to get to know the District through his experience meeting local residents, supporting small businesses and local organizations, and learning about how #IL10 families really want their representative to vote in Washington. **Click Below to Follow** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-n/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-p/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-x/)
**Share with Your Friends!**
We also need your help! You can download the Social Media Toolkit below to share your support with your network on your favorite social media channels. Create a post today and don't forget to tag us and use #carrisforcongress. We will share our favorite posts! [Click Here to Download](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-ehkejd-tlidtddjku-m/) **Support Carris for Congress** Jim is on a mission to bring independence, compassion, and common sense to Washington. Your continued financial support will help us reach more voters through our grassroots organizing efforts. Together, we can secure a win for Illinois and for our country by sending Jim to our nation's capital! While celebrating Father's Day with my own children this past weekend, I couldn't help but think about my own father. He's an amazing individual who embodies the adventurous spirit and can-do attitude that drives America. He came here with little, worked hard to build financial stability, and eventually started a family. He's never felt the need to hyphenate his identity and continues to believe America is that shining city on the hill that drew him (and millions like him) to this land of opportunity. One of his proudest days continues to be the day he took an oath to America and became an American citizen. He exudes wisdom that comes from a life filled with character-building experiences. He is an inspiration to me and has been a caring and dedicated father to me and my sister and devoted husband to my mother. I cherish our regular phone calls and our holiday gatherings!

In honor of Father's Day, I am posting an excerpt from my recent book, _**The Making of a Generalist**_ , about his decision to come to the United States. I hope you enjoy reading it as much as I did writing it.
### _\- Vikram_
## "The Pursuit of Better"
Mansharamani, Vikram. _The Making of a Generalist_ , Outfox Publishing: 2024, p 4-7.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/949167a3-a852-46b3-9ec5-9a2ca0acf839?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
My father arrived in America in the mid-1960s as a student seeking an automotive technical education. Armed with an associate of applied science degree that he had earned in India in 1957, he enrolled in Roberts' Technical and Trade Schools in Manhattan and began his journey toward acquiring a skill, some know-how, that might enable a better life. Unsurprisingly, there were struggles along the way. He ran out of tuition money. To secure room and board, he lived in a hotel and worked as the overnight front-desk clerk. He made money driving a cab. Throughout it all, he never wavered. He knew America was where he wanted to stay, where he intended to set down roots.
After his stint in Manhattan and now armed with his technical certification from Roberts, a job, and a green card, he returned to India to inform his family that America was going to become his home. When he returned to the United States, this time married, he settled in Queens, New York, among that borough's large community of immigrants from the Indian subcontinent. Finding a cultural network in a new country can be very helpful to immigrants. But for my dad, it was always a beachhead to something grander, not an enclave within which to preserve things left behind. He wasn't content in Queens. He hadn't left India to remain so exclusively among his fellow expatriates. Immigrant, yes, but his migrant mindset made him aware that there was far, far more to America than Queens, including, not insignificantly, towns of green grass, open spaces, and more varied neighbors. And that is where he took his young family when I was nearly five years old.

The choice of rural-suburban Landing, New Jersey, can obscure the fact that my dad is guided by a real spirit of adventure. To a man who had navigated Bombay (Mumbai) as a child, some of the roughest parts of West Africa as a young adult, and then Manhattan and Queens as a budding professional, Landing, a town of just a few thousand, was another thoughtful roll of the dice. Later in life, I learned it was useful to think of people on a spectrum between explorers and exploiters. Explorers take risks and try new things. Exploiters, on the other hand, thrive within what already exists, using (sometimes using up) what they find there. On that spectrum, my father was definitely an explorer.
He was born outside of Karachi in 1937, in what was then part of British-occupied India. In 1947, when he was just over ten years old, his life was upended after the British left and India was partitioned into independent India and Pakistan, which resulted in the Hindus of Pakistan being exiled from their homes. As my father later noted in his journal, "Every day, there were riots, looting, murders and beatings/killings in the streets . . . so one evening, we all walked to the seaport where cargo ships were taking Hindus to India." For the next few days, my young father lived on a few slices of bread (on occasion with butter or jam) and was eventually deposited in Bombay. His journal continues: "We stayed in tents for a couple of weeks" before his family was able to secure employment and begin life anew.
A few years later, after a bit of formal education in India, his adventurous spirit drove him to West Africa, where he secured an opportunity to work with Indian entrepreneurs involved in the automotive business. As his journal notes, "I was offered a job (which I had found through a local Sindhi newspaper) in Freetown, Sierra Leone, as an auto parts salesman. The conditions were as follows: a 2- to 2.5-year commitment, salary sent to your parents in rupees monthly, and you'll be provided lodging, boarding, and all necessary requirements, including to and fro airfares to be paid by the company."

* * *
My father recalls Freetown as not very comfortable: "No tar roads, limited running water, occasional electricity . . . no TV, radio for a limited time each day." Given that, it is unsurprising that he also recalled, "We all used to drink a lot every evening." After some time, he was transferred to the Gold Coast, known today as Ghana. After finishing that contract, he returned to India to see family before seeking another contract in Africa. He noted, "This time, luckily, I was asked to go to Lagos, Nigeria . . . where I was happy. Lagos is more advanced than Freetown and Accra. Most of the people in Nigeria were educated, cultured, and good-mannered." Despite the calls from colleagues to drink every evening, my father enrolled in a correspondent's course at the British Institute of Engineering Technology: "It kept me busy from evening to midnight and all day and nights on the weekends." He earned a certificate in automobile engineering during his eighteen-month stint in Lagos before returning to India again. While at home with family, my father proposed Hong Kongas the destination for his next work adventure. His parents did not approve--Hong Kong seemed too distant, too foreign--so he returned to Nigeria.
**Which is where he listened to stories about America.**
After hearing of a country in which your status was determined by your efforts, where anything was possible for anyone, and where protections in law and property assured the fruits of success were enjoyed by those who created them, my father simply had to learn more. He went to the US embassy in Lagos and gathered all the brochures and papers that were available. He remembered one that had a profound influence on him: "How to Study in America with Little Funds." America was seductive. He simply had to find a way to get there. After applying to several schools, he recalls, "I got a favourable reply from Roberts Technical and Trade School on 57th Street [in] New York--it said admission was available every six months, including student visa guaranteed if enrolled." He broke his contract with his employer, reclaimed his passport, and delivered all documentation to the US embassy in Lagos. Within a week, he had what he today calls the golden ticket: a student visa to come to the United States.
Upon reaching America, he knew his life as an immigrant was over. He had landed on the shores of a country he wished to make his home. However, he also understood that his years as a migrant pursuing ever-better opportunities would continue. Both understandings were soon reflected in his becoming an American citizen, something he recalls with fondness and pride.

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

American
civics education, and specifically the teaching of American
history, is at a crisis point.

In K-12
schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and
content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly
anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in
your local schools.

As a
result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to
be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American
ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats?

Or will
we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a
curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view
of our nation's history?

We must
insist on the latter, both for the sake of truth and for the sake
of our children and America's future.

For this
reason, we have produced the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum-and I'm
writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to
educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens
nationwide.

What is
the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum?

The
Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum is a K-12 history and civics curriculum
that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly
and comprehensively.

This
curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but
by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College-and we are making
it available free of charge.

To be
clear, the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum is not a slap-dash response
to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our
children.

It is a
2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying
American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused
effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of
Hillsdale College in 1844.

And we
need your help to make the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum available to
educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens
nationwide...and to make it available free of charge so that it
will have the greatest impact.

We have
set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the Hillsdale 1776
Curriculum and our other outreach efforts-including Imprimis,
free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school
initiative.

That's an
ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible.

One
reason why your support really matters: Hillsdale College refuses
to accept one penny in taxpayer support-not even indirectly in
the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This makes
our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like
you-citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of
liberty.

We remind
ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission-to provide
"sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable
blessings of civil and religious liberty."

With that
mission in mind, we produced the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum-and
now we need your help to promote it nationwide.

Will you
take this opportunity to support the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum
and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty?

Understanding that a proper education is vital to the
preservation of liberty-and that the anti-American indoctrination
now being forced on too many American children poses an
existential threat to liberty-I hope you will make your most
generous tax-deductible gift today.

I've
included a secure link for your convenience here:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63304129:sTVh8rWNF:m:3:2627245898:A67C9A8CA7DA73D6B400225E6FDAB00B:r

Thank you
for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

#

Hey Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
**There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.**
So before I ask you to chip in toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.

Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.
Once he left active duty, Lucas turned his focus to the corrupt politicians and corporate monopolies that dominate our economy and squeeze small businesses. He took on everyone from Big Tech and Big Ag to defense contractors and pharmaceutical companies.
**Now, Lucas is running to defeat January 6th coward Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat for real, everyday people.**
**[ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52583?refcode=em20240618-5792&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5792%2E614464%2ExaeoK0)**
Let’s just be clear here: Hawley’s January 6th cowardice isn’t the only reason he’s incapable of representing my home state.
**Since he was elected to office, Josh Hawley hasn’t fought to bring even $0.01 back to our communities — but he’s had plenty of time to make money for himself.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52583?refcode=em20240618-5792&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5792%2E614464%2ExaeoK0)
While giant corporations strip our state of opportunity and jack up prices, Hawley is only focused on enriching himself. He’s made hundreds of thousands of dollars more than his congressional salary by selling his weird book all about _"Manhood."_
**All this, while he made taxpayers cover the cost of his own lawbreaking.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52583?refcode=em20240618-5792&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5792%2E614464%2ExaeoK0)
Missouri can’t afford another six years of Hawley in the Senate, Peter , and voters of all stripes seem to agree.
_Morning Consult_ reported that Josh Hawley has the lowest approval rating of any Republican incumbent up for re-election this November. And even Hawley’s own former mentor, Missouri’s three-term Republican U.S. Senator Jack Danforth, said supporting Hawley was _“the worst decision I’ve ever made in my life.”_
After spending a whole year consolidating support from workers, community leaders, and organizations across Missouri, Lucas Kunce has more than proved that he has what it takes to win this race. Multiple polls even confirm he’s in a dead heat with Hawley. That’s why I’m asking for your help, Peter:
**[Will you join me in supporting my friend Lucas Kunce by chipping in $10 or more today? With so much at stake in this election — and with a race this close — no one can afford to sit on the sidelines.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52583?refcode=em20240618-5792&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=5792%2E614464%2ExaeoK0)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52584?refcode=em20240618-5792&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=7&akid=5792%2E614464%2ExaeoK0) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52584?refcode=em20240618-5792&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=5792%2E614464%2ExaeoK0) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/52583?refcode=em20240618-5792&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=5792%2E614464%2ExaeoK0)

Lucas won’t be another shady, corrupt politician. He’s put his money where his mouth is since day one — refusing to accept any money from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or Big Oil and Big Pharma executives.
**He’s running to be a real warrior for working Missourians, unbeholden to anyone other than the everyday people who elected him to office.**
Lucas will fight for investment in our state — rebuilding forgotten communities, creating jobs, and empowering workers. He’ll stand up to the attacks on reproductive rights by controlling politicians like Hawley. He’ll work to end the corporate grip on power in our country, by banning insider trading and abolishing corporate PACs. And he’ll be accountable to real, everyday Missourians.
I can’t tell you how excited I am about everything we’ll be able to accomplish in Missouri with Lucas fighting for us in the Senate, Peter. But if we’re going to take advantage of this historic opportunity, Lucas urgently needs your help.

**The Edge of Nature** Opens at LA MAMA in NYC June 14-30!
["Sheer Brilliance"](https://substack.com/redirect/05c9f79e-a201-4146-a9c9-acc203bdd92d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
["I was totally enthralled"](https://substack.com/redirect/85f60e73-fb7d-40fc-96ba-7e351f3a2579?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Those are some quotes from [the recent article in COMMON DREAMS](https://substack.com/redirect/e8d3875e-09d0-4715-a823-5513dc2badb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about **THE EDGE OF NATURE** , my new film/performance that opens Friday in New York City!
Jessica Corbett writes:
"Josh Fox's **The Edge of Nature** is about more than where nature begins or ends. It's a startling documentary that explores long Covid, PTSD, climate, genocide, survival, purpose, and healing during a time when questions of personal, public, and planetary health converged."
Beginning June 14, Fox is set to couple the resulting film with a live musical [performance](https://substack.com/redirect/d15678f2-65a5-4d74-9831-b22c89982f8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), featuring a 12-person ensemble, for three weeks at La MaMa Experimental Theatre Club in New York City.
[Read the whole article here!](https://substack.com/redirect/394999ba-6b88-4b81-82d0-774a44967de1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Tix are going fast, so [get yours today!](https://substack.com/redirect/61411fa7-e811-4823-826c-ee6ad8c476c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Click here for tickets](https://substack.com/redirect/019d629e-a3bd-4db2-b7f4-afe41e288882?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The article continues:
"The banjo and songs of Pete Seeger--whose influence Fox can trace back to the folk legend visiting his elementary school--are just part of the film's soundtrack. There are also blue jays and coyotes. The rustle of the forest, filled with bears and beavers. The clicks of typewriter keys. Occasional gunshots in the distance. Radio reports about the intertwined public health and economic crises."
Just as Kathy Hochul threatens our NY State Fracking ban and all of our environmental progress, [I am opening this new film that ](https://substack.com/redirect/2dea39da-48d9-41fe-8409-160cc89d8137?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)celebrates our frack free forests. [THE EDGE OF NATURE](https://substack.com/redirect/dd2271e4-2741-4a8d-945e-f0f7ebc104fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is a love letter to the very areas in NY and PA that the fracking ban saved.
It is called [THE EDGE OF NATURE ](https://substack.com/redirect/367ccf22-b19c-49c8-a5d2-29f6b938df7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and it opens this Friday June 14th. The film celebrates the New York watershed and the forests of PA- it dives deep into why nature is so important to all life on the planet and how we have to fight for it. [I made the film to fight for our environment and our climate.](https://substack.com/redirect/b33ebbf1-dbe7-4dbe-9ecb-42728b31fc5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I am actually doing a LIVE performance version of the film every night- all the music and narration live with a 12 member ensemble.
**[Because of Kathy Hochul's recent attacks on our fracking Ban our Saturday night show will be FREE for activists.](https://substack.com/redirect/fa638f82-58a8-467f-83b3-3788e613371d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Use this code](https://substack.com/redirect/4d984ec9-d8cc-474c-8f76-58a6b6b2ad64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): PROTEST
**[Every night that we perform the film,](https://substack.com/redirect/d5eecb61-f83f-47c6-97eb-efb1f4859c6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Extinction Rebellion NYC and I will be at the theater to talk over the issues and mobilize. Please come to the film and get organized with us.**
Every other night it is only $10 with this CODE: ExtReb10 (we gotta pay the theater something- if it was up to me the show would be free for activists every night!)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/407b4a8a-f04d-45af-9cc1-83d36e0bdc59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Come down to the theater and let's organize.](https://substack.com/redirect/0986de5e-f072-43f5-a581-b8f6f71346e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We need to reassemble the powerful movement we built ten years ago. We can do it. They can't get away with this.
And CALL GOV HOCHUL AND TELL HER TO KEEP THE FRACKING BAN IN TACT!
518-474-8390
Please call her today and [come down and see us to ORGANIZE!](https://substack.com/redirect/ba99af24-a9eb-4b5f-9d5d-c0206788a65e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
BAN ALL FRACKING NOW AND ALWAYS!
In solidarity,
Josh Fox

| That young guy, missing his two front teeth with a curious look in his eye? Yup, that’s me!And if you had told him that nowadays, I’d be running for the U.S. Senate from the great state of California, he would no doubt be very pleased — but genuinely shocked.You see, growing up, I was fascinated by history and politics.Sitting around the dinner table at night, we’d talk about the news of the day or the history book my father was reading at the moment.The conversation was always dynamic — my dad comes from a long line of Democrats, and my mom from a long line of Republicans (in fact, her father was a Republican County chairman at one point, so you can imagine the discourse at larger family gatherings!).Back then, Democrats and Republicans disagreed with each other about plenty of issues, but you could disagree without being disagreeable.What changed? Many things. How we get our information. Cable news. Algorithms set to exploit fear and anger.**And Donald J. Trump became President. And when he became president, he sought new and inventive ways to divide us. And used many of the old ones, like bigotry and hate.** When I started in politics, Democrats and Republicans would work together to get things done. They often disagreed — _strongly_ — but they put the best interests of the American people first and found areas where they could agree.**But those days feel long gone now.** We have seen a seismic shift in the last few years — since a charlatan celebrity and reality TV host who called disabled veterans “suckers” and “losers,” denigrated our immigrant communities, and railed on about “fake news” was elected President of the United States.I’ve never been one to back down from the bullies — so amidst these attacks, I did my duty and called him out and held him to account. I took on these fights not because they were easy, but because they needed to be done.**And for taking on those fights, I’ve become Trump’s favorite boogeyman and enemy.** The little boy in the picture at the beginning of this email never would have imagined bearing the brunt of attacks from a U.S. President and his cronies in Congress and the far-right media.But if standing up for our democracy, for our rights and freedoms, and for our Constitution has earned me the enmity of Trump and the MAGA movement, then that’s a badge of honor I will wear proudly every day.[**_These are the fights I’m going to take on in the U.S. Senate — where many of Trump’s chief enablers reside. Which is why Trump is doing everything he can to stop me from winning. Please, help me keep up this fight by pitching in a split donation of $20 or any amount you can spare between No Dem Left Behind and our campaign today._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ndlb_ca_split?refcode=share)

If you are unsure of your polling location or have any questions about the voting process, please visit the Oklahoma State Election Board website or contact my office for assistance. #### The winding road to what became one of the city’s great art installations — and how we kept it from being dismantled.
---
| Dive into the musings of acclaimed author and columnist **Thom Nickels**. This latest piece by Nickels discusses the _Dream Garden_ mural in Philadelphia's Curtis Center.

The mural, created by Maxfield Parrish and Louis C. Tiffany, faced potential removal in 1998 when an anonymous buyer planned to relocate it to Las Vegas.

Public outcry led to protests and legal battles, culminating in the mural's preservation in Philadelphia. Nickels' article highlights the community's role in saving this artistic landmark and the importance of public art in cultural heritage.

"It began with a man named Edward Bok, who as a young man published a few pieces in the Brooklyn Eagle, a newspaper once edited by Walt Whitman. The hard-working Bok went to night school and in 1887 became an ad manager at Scribner’s magazine..."

## About Thom Nickels:
---
| |
---
Thom Nickels is a Philadelphia-based journalist/author and the 2005 recipient of the Philadelphia AIA Lewis Mumford Award for Architectural Journalism. He has written for _The Philadelphia Inquirer_ , the _Philadelphia Daily News_ , _Welcomat_ , _American Catholic Studies_ , _Philadelphia Magazine_. He currently writes for _City Journal_ , _New York_ , _Frontpage Magazine_ and _Broad + Liberty_. body:

are more great women
Peter,
As long-time activists, organizers, and community leaders in Northern Virginia, we've seen firsthand the power of women supporting women. That's why we worked tirelessly to elect Jennifer Wexton to Congress in 2018, and why we're now coming together to support Jennifer Boysko as her successor.
Jennifer Boysko has been a fierce advocate for women's rights in the Virginia legislature. She carried the amendment to enshrine abortion access in our state constitution and championed the bill to establish paid family and medical leave. We know that she will continue this fight in Congress, standing up for equal pay, reproductive freedom, and the fundamental principle that no one should dictate what we can do with our bodies.
https://jenniferboysko.com/2024/06/18/elect-women/ [https://jenniferboysko.com/2024/06/18/elect-women/]
But Jennifer's commitment goes beyond women's rights - she is deeply dedicated to this district and the people who call it home. As a legislator, she has represented as many as 200,000 people in this very district. Some of us have voted for her eight times. She knows us, she is there for us; she always has been and she always will be.
Jennifer isn't a stranger or someone we only see on TV or at dinners and speeches. We see her speaking at School Board meetings, knocking on doors for our local candidates, and sitting in living rooms stuffing envelopes. We see her standing with us when no one else can be bothered to show up.
As volunteers and grassroots leaders, we've knocked on doors, made phone calls, and mobilized our communities to elect representatives who share our values. We need a qualified woman who knows this district inside and out, and who will fight like hell to protect our hard-won rights and to get back the ones the Supreme Court has taken away.
Jennifer Boysko is that woman. She has the experience, the passion, and the unwavering commitment to women's rights that we need in our next representative.
We won't sit idly by while extremist Republicans attempt to strip us of our rights. Together, as women, we're standing up and saying: no more.
Join us in supporting Jennifer Boysko for Congress, Peter . Together, we can ensure that women's voices are heard and our rights are protected.
Please share this email or post this link [https://jenniferboysko.com/2024/06/18/elect-women/] on social media today. Tag Jennifer Boysko. Let everyone know that we support her.

Issuing the Largest State Pardon in American History and Fully Reopening the Port of Baltimore
---
| | | | | [](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Mg7WVU0LBLsuy07xJIIOw9cxGAT7uuu4GcQNgdISNQQ/s/3129413633/br/244361925328-l)

| My fellow Marylanders, While the State House may be quieter now that we’re out of the regular legislative session, we are no less busy in Annapolis getting the people’s work done. Just yesterday, **we – again – made history right here in the Annapolis State House.** I’ve issued an executive order pardoning certain Maryland convictions related to the simple possession of cannabis, including convictions for misdemeanor possession of cannabis and convictions for misdemeanor possession of drug paraphernalia. **This historic action impacts hundreds of thousands of Marylanders from across the state**** _and_****from all economic backgrounds.** **It is the largest state pardon in the history of this country** , and a critical first step in addressing the racial wealth gap. There is still much more work to be done, and we're looking forward to getting that work done in partnership with legislators, advocates, and most importantly, you.
---
|
---
| [](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDIsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnlvdXR1YmUuY29tL3dhdGNoP3Y9SGNybzZGY1NJTmciLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwNjE4Ljk2NDI0MjIxIn0.cATFewKeQWvixL7iHjEJ3muDrT159xl662d3Dl-C7Jk/s/3129413633/br/244361925328-l)A few weeks ago, I had an important meeting with President Biden. The White House has been here for Baltimore from the very first hour of this crisis, so I wanted to give him an update on the progress that has been made around the Key Bridge collapse and at the Port of Baltimore. **[Watch here.](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDMsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnlvdXR1YmUuY29tL3dhdGNoP3Y9SGNybzZGY1NJTmciLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwNjE4Ljk2NDI0MjIxIn0.tcTtHH2GcXJ9zPVxdc76uxV3xnfFmWm4Jm8y4dP6AhE/s/3129413633/br/244361925328-l)** [](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..KBJEbFSQ4vc0bB2hgu0Gnm0yM0lLf-JSeMZ6yfJtPcI/s/3129413633/br/244361925328-l)At the beginning of this month, I announced the **[launch of a first-in-the-nation Trevor Train the Trainer pilot program](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..0TmLLiN5-iWl0ooQqP0ZOIb6UBUsnPijyiEUJQxkHuc/s/3129413633/br/244361925328-l)** in partnership with the Maryland Department of Health and The Trevor Project, the leading suicide prevention organization for LGBTQIA+ young people. This first-in-the-nation program partnership with the Trevor Project will ensure that we do more to celebrate the humanity of every Marylander and give greater hope and healing to LGBTQ+ youth. [](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..64TNFEWCP9-jI6zfR9Mxz2iz6lrE_Z0frLFd9961EuI/s/3129413633/br/244361925328-l)At Henderson-Hopkins in Baltimore, I joined a panel discussion with some amazing students to talk about climate change and **[signed an Executive Order](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..ylLyeJJNNXFLGr0VrGo9YRYGmScm9g3HZbHARzO_ci4/s/3129413633/br/244361925328-l) to advance Maryland’s Climate Pollution Reduction Plan**. This order is one of the most comprehensive on climate change issued by a Maryland governor and directs a whole-of-government approach to address climate change. [](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..99sH4U86qPc1E6i_xnk6VTK0Tg2rJZCeIBAqA04bHXs/s/3129413633/br/244361925328-l)On Friday, June 7th, we signed a **[memorandum of understanding](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..hbN6G8ZSk23ESi8Qwcls6n8CCHn8i0tP1TbVlAPvVps/s/3129413633/br/244361925328-l) with the U.S. Bureau of Ocean Energy Management** to make Maryland more competitive through offshore wind development. Offshore wind means new manufacturing jobs, higher wages, and more opportunity to grow wealth for Maryland families. I’m grateful to the Biden-Harris Administration and all of our partners at the local, state, and federal levels for their partnership in this work. Together, we will build an economy that is both green and growing.

This moment was not given – it was earned:
* **Unified Command** has removed over 50,000 tons of bridge wreckage – without any major injuries.

* **The** **Biden-Harris Administration** helped us stand up SBA Recovery Centers to help people and businesses affected by the collapse, and delivered $60 million in emergency funding just days after the Bridge fell.

subject: [BUMP STOCKS UPDATE] The Senate is planning to hold a vote on banning bump stocks
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Congress must do the right thing and act to keep bump stocks out of our communities.
#

Friends, in case you missed it, last week the Supreme Court struck down the ATF’s bump stock ban. Bump stocks turn semi-automatic weapons into fully automatic machine guns. They should be illegal.
The ATF’s bump stock ban took effect back in 2017 after a mass shooter—who was armed with AR-15s accessorized with bump stocks—opened fire at the Route 91 Harvest music festival in Las Vegas. Within minutes, over 1000 rounds were fired, killing 60 people and injuring over 400 others.
This Supreme Court decision is reckless, and puts our lives in jeopardy. It’s time for Congress to undo the damage. Democratic Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer announced earlier this week that he will be holding a vote on legislation that would ban bump stocks.
However, even a single senator can block debate on this important issue.
That’s why we need to use our collective voice to show that banning dangerous bump stocks has strong support from our movement.
[**Will you sign our petition right now to call on Congress to reinstate a federal ban on bump stocks?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_bumpstocks_pet_june24/?source=em240618-1-30&refcode2=8335.3935704.8BHq0N&akid=8335%2E3935704%2E8BHq0N)

Summer has just started and we are already seeing extreme weather and high temperatures expected to surpass last year's record impacting communities across the country. LCV Action Fund is especially thrilled to support these new candidates who have a track record of protecting the environment and their communities, and will continue to fight for a clean energy future."_ — LCV Action Fund Senior Vice President for Government Affairs Tiernan Sittenfeld LCV is a powerful force in American environmental politics, leveraging its resources and communication efforts to promote a greener and more sustainable future.**I am honored to have their support as I run for re-election in Congress and I am grateful for their work to keep places like Northwest Washington beautiful for future generations.** LCV takes a wide range of issues into account when endorsing a candidate, including: climate change, democracy, environmental and racial justice, energy, public health, worker protections, public lands, and wildlife conservation. Given their robust rubrics, having their support is even more meaningful. **I firmly believe that these issues must be a top priority.** Here is some of the progress we have made in Congress in the past few years:
* I helped draft and pass the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, which allocates $5.3 billion over five years to provide Washingtonians with more transportation options, ease congestion in local communities, and reduce carbon pollution across the state, in addition to allocating nearly $370 million this year to invest in the state's transit agencies and communities.
* I introduced and helped pass the Migratory Birds of the Americas Conservation Enhancements Act, a bipartisan bill to help protect diverse bird populations and their habitats in the Pacific Northwest and across the Western Hemisphere.
* I supported the bipartisan Water Resources Development Act of 2022 because protecting our natural environment is especially critical to maintaining a healthy economy and community.

As we deal with warmer temperatures, rising sea levels, and climate-caused disasters, I will continue working to ensure our infrastructure can handle the changing climate and keep our communities safe. [**We must address climate change to save lives, and I am ready to continue working to protect our environment alongside LCV. clean_body: I am grateful to have their support both in my run for Congress and keeping Northwest Washington beautiful. | | | | I have earned the endorsement of the League of Conservation Voters (LCV)! ="We're thrilled to announce LCV Action Fund's latest slate of endorsements to support strong climate leaders committed to fighting the climate crisis and environmental injustice. Summer has just started and we are already seeing extreme weather and high temperatures expected to surpass last year's record impacting communities across the country. LCV Action Fund is especially thrilled to support these new candidates who have a track record of protecting the environment and their communities, and will continue to fight for a clean energy future." — LCV Action Fund Senior Vice President for Government Affairs Tiernan Sittenfeld LCV is a powerful force in American environmental politics, leveraging its resources and communication efforts to promote a greener and more sustainable future.I am honored to have their support as I run for re-election in Congress and I am grateful for their work to keep places like Northwest Washington beautiful for future generations. LCV takes a wide range of issues into account when endorsing a candidate, including: climate change, democracy, environmental and racial justice, energy, public health, worker protections, public lands, and wildlife conservation. Given their robust rubrics, having their support is even more meaningful. I firmly believe that these issues must be a top priority. Here is some of the progress we have made in Congress in the past few years: I helped draft and pass the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, which allocates $5.3 billion over five years to provide Washingtonians with more transportation options, ease congestion in local communities, and reduce carbon pollution across the state, in addition to allocating nearly $370 million this year to invest in the state's transit agencies and communities. I introduced and helped pass the Migratory Birds of the Americas Conservation Enhancements Act, a bipartisan bill to help protect diverse bird populations and their habitats in the Pacific Northwest and across the Western Hemisphere. I supported the bipartisan Water Resources Development Act of 2022 because protecting our natural environment is especially critical to maintaining a healthy economy and community. | | Holding the Democratic Senate Majority hinges on winning hard races across the country – including in Nevada, where my good friend and progressive ally Jacky Rosen is running for reelection in a competitive race. There are two things you need to know about this year's Senate election in Nevada:
1. Democrats barely kept Nevada blue in the 2022 Senate race to defend our majority – **winning by just 7,928 votes.**
2. If Jacky loses in Nevada this year, MAGA Republicans WILL take over the Senate and enact their dangerous agenda.

Friend,

I can't tell you how much it means to me that you opened this. Did you know that only about 20-30% of folks open these messages from me?

I do have to ask a quick favor of you - I'm simply asking you to read this all the way through. If you finish reading this and you still think a $1 donation doesn't matter, then I want to just say **[thank you for hearing me out.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/f6ANjXRwyw3UL6nPbUCrWQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoVFbOP0T_)**

He wants Montanans to believe that despite owning a **$1 million castle in DC,** he is just a third-generation dirt farmer from Montana.

Let us repeat that: $141 million. It's terrifying. That is money they will use not only to defeat Joe Biden, but also Democrats running up and down the ballot in November. We're going to be blunt: if Trump's supporters will donate that much money after his conviction, there is no telling what they will do in the future. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: This is what 2024 is about
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Dark money groups aren’t the biggest fans of the these progressive policies
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240618-4002-footer&t=1&akid=4002%2E420207%2EtLU9-2)
Peter, it’s simple: Pramila Jayapal is a progressive champion we can **always** depend on.
That’s why I am very happy to endorse her today for another term of fighting for working people in Congress.
Pramila and I have worked in partnership to make progress on major issues facing our country — including introducing legislation to reform the Supreme Court, making corporations and the wealthiest pay their fair share in taxes, and taking on Big Pharma and private insurance companies.
But there’s more we’ve got to do to protect our democracy, secure reproductive freedoms, and make our government work for working families — and the special interests we’re fighting against will spend big to stop our momentum.
[**So**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240618.kaWo7P&refcode=em20240618-4002&t=2&akid=4002%2E420207%2EtLU9-2)[**Peter, will you please chip in $3 or anything you can so that Pramila and I can continue building progressive power and fighting in Congress together?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240618.kaWo7P&refcode=em20240618-4002&t=3&akid=4002%2E420207%2EtLU9-2)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240618.kaWo7P&refcode=em20240618-4002&t=22&akid=4002%2E420207%2EtLU9-2)**
Yes, 2024 is about defeating Donald Trump. That is a top priority. But it’s also about electing progressive leadership _everywhere_ across the country _._ It’s about going on offense for our progressive policies and values.
So Pramila and I are going to keep fighting side by side to address the root causes of the deep problems in our economy, our government, and our democracy — while we also fight to defeat MAGA extremism.
That’s our path to winning and continuing to make big, structural, progressive change for working people across the country.
[**Like our campaign, Pramila relies on grassroots support to compete against wealthy special interests and dark money groups and continue fighting in Congress. So can you please split $3 or anything you can today to support our progressive movement?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240618.kaWo7P&refcode=em20240618-4002&t=23&akid=4002%2E420207%2EtLU9-2)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth Warren

This ad is about my family. My dad built my childhood home from the ground up. He even put a penny in the foundation from the year the house was built. My dad worked in construction and cleared snow all winter to make ends meet. He had the kind of jobs where you shower after work, not before. Both of my parents taught my sisters and me that excuses won’t solve problems, hard work will.

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/102624/images/BoyskoForCongress_Logo_FINAL.png]
Hey everyone,
I wanted to thank Barb and all the other women who signed this letter.
I know this support has meant the world to Jennifer.
If you have ever volunteered for a campaign, you know the often underestimated importance of organizing and knocking doors. Well we knocked over 25,000 doors just since April! That is amazing and we could not have done it without you.
I wanted to share this article because I think this writer captured the Jennifer's spirit and the defining characteristic of all her campaigns. [https://fairfaxmachine.substack.com/p/in-a-packed-va-10-race-for-congress]
https://fairfaxmachine.substack.com/p/in-a-packed-va-10-race-for-congress [https://fairfaxmachine.substack.com/p/in-a-packed-va-10-race-for-congress]
Here are a few of my favorite passages from the article:
Then she got into her car, tagged with stickers that read "KAINE 2024" and "There is no Planet B" and overdue for maintenance, and she tracked down a stretch of houses she'd missed.
"Door-to-door hustle can 'absolutely' swing a primary, where voters are more persuadable than in a general election, said Jeremy Mayer, an associate professor at George Mason's Schar School of Policy and Government. Door-knocking costs less than yard signs, less than Boysko's digital ads and mailers, and far less than TV."
Once recently during the VA-10 primary she got back in her black Prius after canvassing and its temperature read 109 degrees. Another time, on the south side of Dulles, she got caught in a flash storm that soaked her pants and shoes so badly she had to go home and change.
Barb and I have volunteered on just about every Democratic campaign you can name in this area, and I know many of you have as well.
I hope you'll take a moment to read this article. [https://fairfaxmachine.substack.com/p/in-a-packed-va-10-race-for-congress]
And if you haven't voted today, I hope you will. Do it for all the people who work so hard to try and make the world a little better and a little kinder.
Get Out The Vote!
Kathy Shupe
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/102624/images/BoyskoForCongress_Logo_FINAL.png]
Peter,
As long-time activists, organizers, and community leaders in Northern Virginia, we've seen firsthand the power of women supporting women. That's why we worked tirelessly to elect Jennifer Wexton to Congress in 2018, and why we're now coming together to support Jennifer Boysko as her successor.
Jennifer Boysko has been a fierce advocate for women's rights in the Virginia legislature. She carried the amendment to enshrine abortion access in our state constitution and championed the bill to establish paid family and medical leave. We know that she will continue this fight in Congress, standing up for equal pay, reproductive freedom, and the fundamental principle that no one should dictate what we can do with our bodies.
https://jenniferboysko.com/2024/06/18/elect-women/ [https://jenniferboysko.com/2024/06/18/elect-women/]
But Jennifer's commitment goes beyond women's rights - she is deeply dedicated to this district and the people who call it home. As a legislator, she has represented as many as 200,000 people in this very district. Some of us have voted for her eight times. She knows us, she is there for us; she always has been and she always will be.
Jennifer isn't a stranger or someone we only see on TV or at dinners and speeches. We see her speaking at School Board meetings, knocking on doors for our local candidates, and sitting in living rooms stuffing envelopes. We see her standing with us when no one else can be bothered to show up.
As volunteers and grassroots leaders, we've knocked on doors, made phone calls, and mobilized our communities to elect representatives who share our values. We need a qualified woman who knows this district inside and out, and who will fight like hell to protect our hard-won rights and to get back the ones the Supreme Court has taken away.
Jennifer Boysko is that woman. She has the experience, the passion, and the unwavering commitment to women's rights that we need in our next representative.
We won't sit idly by while extremist Republicans attempt to strip us of our rights. Together, as women, we're standing up and saying: no more.
Join us in supporting Jennifer Boysko for Congress, Peter . Together, we can ensure that women's voices are heard and our rights are protected.
Please share this email or [https://jenniferboysko.com/2024/06/18/elect-women/] post this link [https://jenniferboysko.com/2024/06/18/elect-women/] on social media today. Tag Jennifer Boysko. Let everyone know that we support her.
In solidarity,
Dr. Wendy Klein , Womens Health Advocate Susan Harford , Fauquier Grassroots Community Activist

| | | After bombshell reports revealed that Supreme Court Justices Clarence Thomas and Samuel Alito have gone on lavish vacations paid for by billionaire GOP donors, the Supreme Court decided to adopt a new “code of ethics.” But this code is basically just the honor system – it’s unenforceable and non-binding and doesn’t strengthen the public’s trust in the Supreme Court one bit. The only way to stop the rampant corruption within the Supreme Court is for Congress to enforce a code of ethics, not just trust the Supreme Court to govern themselves. As the highest court in the land continues to chip away at our rights while receiving lavish gifts from GOP donors, [we’re demanding Congress create the strongest possible code of conduct for the Supreme Court. name: Team Scott
subject: A Legislature out of balance and out of touch
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Phil Scott for Vermont
body:
|
---
| | [ ](https://philscott.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bbb0245bb16226cd6570f0156&id=88dea1690c&e=19cebfe173)
---
| Friend,
---
| Do you think Vermonters can afford a historic 14% property tax hike? How about a new, nearly $100 million payroll tax coming July 1? What about hundreds of millions more for electricity bills, or hundreds or thousands of dollars more per year for Vermonters to heat their homes and businesses?

This Legislature thinks so... and then some.

These are just a handful of examples of the damage this Super Majority in the Legislature has done to working families, retirees and small businesses over the last 18 months.

**Vermonters have been clear: they have had enough**. But the Super Majority in the Legislature has repeatedly ignored the pleas of their constituents and pushed through these initiatives over the Governor’s vetoes.

As the Governor said yesterday, he had spent the entire legislative session trying to keep costs down for Vermonters, while acting to make housing more affordable and more available, improving our education system for kids and taxpayers, and revitalizing communities so we can keep and attract the workers we desperately need.

**It is clear that this Legislature, led by the Super Majority, had little interest in compromise, listening to their constituents, or taking a moderate approach on any issue.**

[That’s why we need your help.](https://philscott.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bbb0245bb16226cd6570f0156&id=25b96a751b&e=19cebfe173) We desperately need to elect a more balanced, moderate and common sense Legislature that will put Vermonters’ interests first, not special interests first.

We need a Legislature that will actually work with the Governor to prioritize how to _lower_ costs for Vermonters, not spend their time focusing on which taxes, fees or penalties to hit Vermonters with next.

The Governor can’t do it alone in Montpelier. **He needs reinforcements**. And we’ll be working hard to support pragmatic, common sense candidates for the House and Senate.

We need your help to continue getting the message out. Whether it’s a [contribution](https://philscott.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bbb0245bb16226cd6570f0156&id=ee25f288cd&e=19cebfe173), volunteering, or talking to your neighbors and friends -- everyone can play a part in holding this Legislature accountable, and helping us restore balance in November.

\- Team Scott

subject: The 2024 elections are NOT a foregone conclusion
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends, let’s talk about something important:
The outcomes of the 2024 elections are NOT a foregone conclusion.
We all read the news. We listen to podcasts. We see the breakdown of the Senate map and the path to flipping the House, see all the polls, and hear about the likelihood of winning or losing certain seats. In this media environment, with confident predictions flying left and right, it’s easy to start to believe certain outcomes are guaranteed.
But I want to remind you that that’s simply not the case. Quite the opposite:
What happens in November depends on what we do right now!
Whether you feel like a race is hopelessly lost to the extreme GOP, or a candidate is a sure bet in a blue district, the reality is that neither of those things is true .
The news we’ll wake up to on November 6th rests in our hands, and the measures we take over the next 20 weeks or so have very real power.
Today, I’m asking you to take action to help ensure the outcomes we’re fighting for. We *can* flip the House, we *can* defeat MAGA extremists, and we *can* re-elect Joe Biden. But we won’t get it done if we don’t try. So how about it?
Will you chip in any amount – whether that’s $5, $50, or $500 – to help make it happen? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

Hey team, Last week, the Supreme Court upheld one of the safest and most accessible forms of abortion. This is a huge win for the fundamental right of all women to access reproductive healthcare. As a father of four girls, this issue is personal for me. I'll protect reproductive rights as governor. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87142521/480179519/-54493765?refcode=EM_FL_MUL_20240618_fr_scotusrepro_cand_oc_act_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MzAxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MTJiNTQzMC05ZTJkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FZ9mtveJZgXnSoAHtqPqPG4uHUPZXHLPWtuo9Qv97po=)

I’m proud to live in Washington because we will always defend fundamental rights – and reproductive freedom is a fundamental right. Since the Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_ , we’ve opened our state up to fellow Americans who come to Washington to get reproductive care.
We set up two funds to take care of providers and patients. We will protect our providers and patients by not cooperating with other states who want to take retaliatory action against Washingtonians.
**Make no mistake, the attacks against abortion rights will keep coming.**
Since 2013, I’ve had a 100% voting record protecting Washingtonians’ reproductive rights. As Governor, while leading the charge to make Washington more affordable and safer, I will continue to protect progress and defend women’s health care in the Governor’s Mansion.

\*\*Meet Bernie Moreno:\*\*

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=11765444.4953.1.4bef512cb5345349a0c8289ba963f1e1 ) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

The scheme boosted revenues at The Epoch Times by about 410%, and some of those dollars went directly to efforts to re-elect Trump in 2020. name: IlhanOmar.com
subject: AIPAC's attacks on Jamaal Bowman are an attack on our entire movement
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
None of us — not Ilhan, not Jamaal, nor any of our progressive allies — are going to be able to out-raise AIPAC. What we can do is out-work, out-mobilize, and out-organize them.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1196%2E791427%2EljwoGk)
Friends -
It's no secret that AIPAC is coming after our progressive movement with a vengeance this election cycle, but in recent weeks they've stepped up their attacks against Jamaal Bowman in New York's 16th district like we've never seen before.
Their dark-money super PAC has blanketed the airwaves with more than **_$12 million**_ in attack ads, and with primary day in New York just 7 days away, they're showing no signs of slowing down.
**AIPAC and their billionaire allies' attacks on Jamaal are an attack on our entire progressive movement's fight for justice, which is why it's so important we all stand united in this critical moment.**
That's why we're asking:
**[Will you split a $3 contribution — that's $1.50 for each team — between Jamaal Bowman and Ilhan's campaigns today? Every donation will go directly toward keeping two of our movement's leading voices in Congress.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-june24-bowman.p3fAIP&refcode=em240618-1-1&t=2&akid=1196%2E791427%2EljwoGk)**
_If you've stored your info with ActBlue, your contribution will be split between Jamaal Bowman and Ilhan Omar instantly._
| | **[Donate $3](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/14?c0=io-em-june24-bowman.WqoSa8&refcode=em240618-1-1&t=21&akid=1196%2E791427%2EljwoGk)**
---
****
| **[Donate $25](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/15?c0=io-em-june24-bowman.GKfagr&refcode=em240618-1-1&t=22&akid=1196%2E791427%2EljwoGk)**

****

---
****
| **[Donate $100](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/9?c0=io-em-june24-bowman.7Z_a2N&refcode=em240618-1-1&t=24&akid=1196%2E791427%2EljwoGk)**
---
****
| | **[Donate $250](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/10?c0=io-em-june24-bowman.z0vnvS&refcode=em240618-1-1&t=25&akid=1196%2E791427%2EljwoGk)**
---
****
| **[Other Amount](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/13?c0=io-em-june24-bowman.Ak10IB&refcode=em240618-1-1&t=26&akid=1196%2E791427%2EljwoGk)**
---
****
By now, we all know AIPAC and their "United Democracy Project" super PAC's playbook.
Ilhan's seen it before in our own district here in Minnesota. We've seen it in Michigan and Pennsylvania against our allies Rashida Tlaib and Summer Lee, too.
Essentially, any candidate who dares speak out against Israel's right-wing Netanyahu government, against their occupation and apartheid system in Palestine, or in favor of conditioning the U.S.'s billions of dollars in military aid earns a giant target on their back.
AIPAC then rallies their GOP-supporting donors to make massive, undisclosed donations, often to the tune of millions of dollars. In fact, a recent report shows AIPAC is the _single biggest source of Republican contributions into Democratic primaries._
They use their unlimited funds to cut vicious, bigoted attack ads and flood the TV markets. They drown out any hope of grassroots, people-powered campaigns like ours getting their message out to the voters. And they hold out hope that with enough spending, they can silence our movement all together, once and for all.
The fact of the matter is that none of us — not Ilhan, not Jamaal, nor any of our progressive allies — are going to be able to out-raise AIPAC. What we _can_ do is out-work, out-mobilize, and out-organize them.
Doing that still takes a considerable amount of resources. Resources that we're raising the right way — _together._
**[So please: Split your $3 contribution — that's $1.50 for each team — between Jamaal Bowman and Ilhan's campaigns today.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-june24-bowman.p3fAIP&refcode=em240618-1-1&t=27&akid=1196%2E791427%2EljwoGk)**
Thank you for any support you're able to chip in.
In solidarity,
Team Ilhan
**[Split a donation](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-june24-bowman.p3fAIP&refcode=em240618-1-1&t=28&akid=1196%2E791427%2EljwoGk)**

We are officially ONE week out from Rep. Jamaal Bowman’s primary

establishment like Hillary Clinton.

His opponent, a conservative career politician masquerading as a Democrat,
has made a litany of racist, Islamophobic remarks and refuses to support a
ceasefire in Gaza or Biden’s proposal to raise taxes on the wealthiest few
to better fund our communities.

it!

Why should voters believe that the guy bankrolled by MAGA donors would be

This extremely competitive and expensive House primary is a major test for
