| In February of this year, **Texans finally saw an end to tyrannical COVID vaccine mandates with the implementation of Senate Bill 7. This legislation** , authored by Sen. Mayes Middleton and passed with overwhelming support in the third special legislative session of 2023, **prohibits private entities from requiring the COVID vaccine for anyone performing work in exchange for a benefit (whether paid or unpaid)**. This sweeping law provides protection for everyone from volunteers to interns to employees, closing a dark chapter for Texans that began in the spring of 2021. **Unfortunately, TFVC continues to receive reports about egregious violations of SB7** , mostly from college students registering for healthcare-related degree programs or clinical rotations. We strive to advocate for these students and others with the help of Sen. Middleton and his staff, but these violators must ultimately be held accountable if we are to enjoy unbridled medical liberty in Texas. **I****n the near future, the Senate Committee on Health and Human Services will hold a hearing on SB7 and TFVC will be there to report on compliance** , but we need to hear from YOU if you or your loved ones have been on the receiving end COVID vaccine mandates since February 2024.****

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | In February of this year, Texans finally saw an end to tyrannical COVID vaccine mandates with the implementation of Senate Bill 7. This legislation , authored by Sen. Mayes Middleton and passed with overwhelming support in the third special legislative session of 2023, prohibits private entities from requiring the COVID vaccine for anyone performing work in exchange for a benefit (whether paid or unpaid). This sweeping law provides protection for everyone from volunteers to interns to employees, closing a dark chapter for Texans that began in the spring of 2021. Unfortunately, TFVC continues to receive reports about egregious violations of SB7 , mostly from college students registering for healthcare-related degree programs or clinical rotations. We strive to advocate for these students and others with the help of Sen. Middleton and his staff, but these violators must ultimately be held accountable if we are to enjoy unbridled medical liberty in Texas. In the near future, the Senate Committee on Health and Human Services will hold a hearing on SB7 and TFVC will be there to report on compliance , but we need to hear from YOU if you or your loved ones have been on the receiving end COVID vaccine mandates since February 2024.** | | | | | | | News | | | | | , we got to know Shelley Luther, the Dallas salon owner who defied COVID lockdown orders and newly elected Republican nominee for State Representative in House District 62. | | | | | | Last week, the Texas Democrats released their newly adopted 2024 Platform, and it seems they are still obsessed with the misinformation scare tactic. From the U.S.’s disastrous retreat in Afghanistan and the war in Ukraine to the horrific terror attack on October 7 and the subsequent wars in the Middle East, the world has been thrown into chaos. This is to say nothing of the daily threats that the People’s Republic of China is making in the Far East.

The causes of these problems are not found in Moscow, Tehran, Tokyo, or Taipei. Rather, they are the result of two fundamental and interrelated grand strategic mistakes made by the U.S.:
1. A failure to perceive the threat from the PRC.

[](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=e1b95b93f0&e=8c80cba7e7)
| Dear ,
Summer is no time for vacation from the campaign trail! Our team has been working hard to connect with voters across the 28th District by hitting the doors and attending events.
---
| I am grateful to have such wonderful and enthusiastic volunteers coming alongside me. Thank you to everyone who is helping!
While having the best volunteer team is an enormous asset, we also need to continue to raise the funding that is necessary to get our message to voters. Progressive groups are aggressively targeting swing races throughout Pennsylvania and are pouring in money from major liberal donors. Although it is still early in the campaign, according to the latest financial reports, our opponent has outspent us just over 3 to 1. We are coming up on the critical end-of-quarter 2 deadline. If you are able to make a contribution and/or attend one of our upcoming events to close out Q2, we would greatly appreciate it!

---
[DONATE](https://voteshaffer.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5a4998b6ce4b01517c474232e&id=dfc0af25f3&e=8c80cba7e7)
| **Lay of the Land:** I have been knocking on doors and talking with hundreds of voters from all parts of the 28th District. People desperately want solutions to move Pennsylvania and our country forward. There is a strong sentiment that we are not headed in the right direction and many are concerned about the future for their children and grandchildren. My message of being a problem-solver and consensus builder who will strive to provide opportunities here in PA, reduce tax burdens, and make government more efficient resonates very well with voters.
In today’s climate, we have one of the most polarized electorates ever, with very strong opinions about our top-of-the-ticket races. This is why it is so important to communicate with voters one-on-one. Talking with voters, I have found that whether Republican, Democrat, or Independent, they want safe communities, good schools, quality roads and bridges, clean air and water, and reasonable taxes that don’t take more and more of their hard-earned money. Despite the divisiveness of this election cycle, it is still possible to win over voters of all party backgrounds with our positive message of moving PA forward.
**Critical Events:** Please join us at one of our two events to close out Q2. On Tuesday, June 25th, we have a fundraising event at the Duquesne Club hosted by Tom and Sandy Usher, Al and Mary Barbour, and many others. Then, on Sunday afternoon June 30th, we are hosting a picnic and campaign kick-off event at Pine Park from 3 PM-5 PM. We hope that you can attend one or both! To RSVP for either of these, you can respond to this email or contact us at [info@VoteShaffer.com](mailto:infor@voteshaffer.com?subject=&body=).
* June 25th, 6 PM-8 PM: Fundraiser at the Duquesne Club — Hosted by Tom and Sandy Usher & Al and Mary Barbour — Tickets are $250 and sponsorship levels available at $1,000; $2,500; and $5,000

---
[](mailto:info@voteshaffer.com?subject=RSVP%20to%206%2F25%20Fundrasier&body=)
|
* June 30th, 3 PM-5 PM: “Friendraiser Picnic” at Pine Park — Suggested contributions: $30 per person or $50 per family

---
[](mailto:info@voteshaffer.com?subject=RSVP%20to%20Friendraiser%20Picnic&body=)
| **How to Help** One of the most common questions we get asked is “How can we help?” There are so many things that can be done with volunteers! There is literally something for everyone. Here is a list of just some of the activities we need help with:
\- Put door hangers on doors in your neighborhood\- Address postcards/envelopes\- Help man a booth at an event\- Make phone calls to target/swing voters\- Put together yard signs\- Host a Meet and Greet at your house\- Invite Jeremy to speak at a club or group
If you can help, just reply to this email and let us know what you are interested/able to do and we will get you connected!
Thank you again for your continued support!
Respectfully,

clean_body: | | | | | | | Dear , Summer is no time for vacation from the campaign trail! Our team has been working hard to connect with voters across the 28th District by hitting the doors and attending events. | I am grateful to have such wonderful and enthusiastic volunteers coming alongside me. Thank you to everyone who is helping! While having the best volunteer team is an enormous asset, we also need to continue to raise the funding that is necessary to get our message to voters. Progressive groups are aggressively targeting swing races throughout Pennsylvania and are pouring in money from major liberal donors. Although it is still early in the campaign, according to the latest financial reports, our opponent has outspent us just over 3 to 1. We are coming up on the critical end-of-quarter 2 deadline. If you are able to make a contribution and/or attend one of our upcoming events to close out Q2, we would greatly appreciate it! | Lay of the Land: I have been knocking on doors and talking with hundreds of voters from all parts of the 28th District. People desperately want solutions to move Pennsylvania and our country forward. There is a strong sentiment that we are not headed in the right direction and many are concerned about the future for their children and grandchildren. My message of being a problem-solver and consensus builder who will strive to provide opportunities here in PA, reduce tax burdens, and make government more efficient resonates very well with voters. In today’s climate, we have one of the most polarized electorates ever, with very strong opinions about our top-of-the-ticket races. This is why it is so important to communicate with voters one-on-one. Talking with voters, I have found that whether Republican, Democrat, or Independent, they want safe communities, good schools, quality roads and bridges, clean air and water, and reasonable taxes that don’t take more and more of their hard-earned money. Despite the divisiveness of this election cycle, it is still possible to win over voters of all party backgrounds with our positive message of moving PA forward. Dear Fellow American,

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.
This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.

To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**

**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis.
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=497bc21a0446471d8ad4e8a26a1cb7b7&_e=KPMvxjzFVguhSqRt8CR0teCLG9ZPXXYj1bHx9llQPikO5Ndt53m3YgQyBa1ms_mDrctsmP2eThZwc0D4XepfVRORaTqoykIDYQJ7ERzmxJEDe92bqn2poYs14v5bpQo2GNh0HjtfEtz_QosHZgebl-wBvAvbiaz273-ubU7feYf8PpP4hy306esuphUa7Ld-uqfctMXB8MmFpjQfQDmjWuJozL3HICVBiix_mUEPOkIkjIuQ93H-kWvsEN3d3NyFIfo7gRe3hCrA5_4VjlyZqqdc_TrmpOSqwg_FB2d0S_LagaGVPWsmzNDAXAhGWlSGhJkMKKc8XvZ75cGYcNxSC3yCod9V-v24F3HXME3z2LP-aoarMJkLki_7ZNn5TycS9_G7HVnSjXMOi5qnKV3S8bvL7rSRBUuZ2t6SW6mhX4g%3D)
If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of **" The Second World Wars"** on DVD:

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=497bc21a0446471d8ad4e8a26a1cb7b7&_e=KPMvxjzFVguhSqRt8CR0teCLG9ZPXXYj1bHx9llQPikO5Ndt53m3YgQyBa1ms_mDrctsmP2eThZwc0D4XepfVRORaTqoykIDYQJ7ERzmxJEDe92bqn2poYs14v5bpQo2GNh0HjtfEtz_QosHZgebl-wBvAvbiaz273-ubU7feYf8PpP4hy306esuphUa7Ld-uqfctMXB8MmFpjQfQDmjWuJozL3HICVBiix_mUEPOkIkjIuQ93H-kWvsEN3d3NyFIfo7gRe3hCrA5_4VjlyZqr_nIt8jerIFrHdnaRT1UxXnpfbc6q0VcVLpEiIdxdrJZYBxxfdGnacot3yNyIWHrFBoOgN3gADiMRDD4tqKHJplOzTKo1Gw-J1dTBTxu3_C-gc7-Cgu77DdeGp1utgenZgqJ6a2Q06fNOnzRVS5fDs%3D)**

Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.
Executive Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12698326?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

I hope all my fellow dads out there enjoyed a wonderful **Father’s Day** weekend with your families. **One of life’s greatest gifts has been being a father to my four boys!** Let’s never forget to thank our fathers and continue to be good fathers as we bring up the next generation to follow Christ and keep America great.

Thank you for your continued support as I serve as your **House District 24 State Representative** in our legislature. I’m only just getting started! I look forward to working tirelessly for you in the upcoming legislative session to make our state and communities better places for future generations of Floridians.
---
|
---
| _Representative Chamberlin with his four sons, Ryan, Rey, Royce, and Regan._
---
| | **Saturday, June 15 - Walking Doors in Support of Reps. Carolina Amesty and Doug Bankson**
---
|
---
|
---
---
| I had a great time knocking on doors with fellow conservatives in **House District 45** for **Representative Carolina Amesty** and **House District 39** for **Representative Doug Bankson**. It was a pleasure to help support their campaigns for re-election by spreading the word about the great work these freedom-first leaders have done for our state and their individual communities in the **Florida House**.
---
| | **Thursday, June 13 - Palm Cay Republicans Meeting**
---
|
---
| I had the wonderful opportunity to speak to the **Palm Cay Republicans** group about the legislation we passed during the **2024 Legislative Session** and ideas for future legislation. I also was excited to answer questions and address the concerns they had regarding our state government.
---
| | **Wednesday, June 12 - Meetings with Stakeholders & Constituents**
---
| My office had a busy day of meetings with stakeholders and constituents to discuss legislation for the upcoming**2025 Legislative Session**. It was great to learn more from the community about how I can build a brighter future for our state and district in **Tallahassee**.
---
| | **Tuesday, June 11 - Ribbon-Cutting Ceremony for UF Health Ocala Neighborhood Hospital – Emergency Room**
---
|
---
|
---
---
| It was great to attend the ribbon-cutting ceremony for **UF Health Ocala Neighborhood Hospital** – **Emergency Room**. This facility in **NW Ocala** will include emergency rooms, an outpatient center, a rehab clinic, X-ray, CT, MRI machines, and more. This addition to our community will bring many jobs and greater access to healthcare!
---
| | **Legislation Signed into Law by Governor Ron DeSantis**
---
| Last week, **Governor Ron DeSantis** signed a slate of legislation into law that will help Florida families in so many ways, [including our new state budget for the **2024-2025 Fiscal Year**](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=f1d0af2c18&e=d1c1b9864f). * [SB 2518 – Health and Human Services](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=00db8822c0&e=d1c1b9864f)

The Colorado Court of Appeals has found Denver's 9News could potentially be held liable in a [fatal shooting of a Trump supporter](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) during a 2020 protest in Denver.
Matthew Dolloff, an unlicensed security guard allegedly acquired by a contractor 9News used, was accompanying a 9News producer at a protest between the group "Patriot Muster" and a "BLM-Antifa Soup Drive" when he shot and killed Trump supporter Lee Keltner, according to [CBS News](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
Denver District Attorney Beth McCann refused to prosecute at the time of the shooting: "Under Colorado's law, Matthew Dolloff had no duty to retreat and was legally justified in his actions. While I do not agree with Mr. Dolloff's decision to use lethal force, the fact remains he had the right to do so under our law," she said in her [official statement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Nursing homes go dark as more utilities cut power to prevent wildfires](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Xcel Energy cut power to 52,000 homes, including the [Frasier nursing home](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Boulder, to prevent wildfires, giving residents just 75 minutes' notice. Frasier, home to nearly 500 residents, managed essential needs with generators during the 28-hour outage but lacked heating as temperatures dropped.
* The incident highlighted the need for better emergency preparedness and communication between utilities and nursing homes to manage sudden outages. Nursing homes face difficulties meeting [federal emergency standards,](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) particularly for new challenges like public safety power shut-offs, with significant retrofitting costs.
* Efforts are increasing to better [integrate nursing homes](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) into community disaster plans and prioritize quicker power restoration to healthcare facilities during emergencies.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Analysis: Trump plan to cut taxes on tips would save taxpayers $250 billion over decade](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE HILL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Former President Trump's plan to [eliminate taxes on tips](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) could decrease federal revenues by $150 to $250 billion over a decade, as estimated by the Committee for a Responsible Federal Drive.
* The analysis did not account for behavioral changes but noted potential shifts towards [reclassifying more income as tips](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), potentially affecting base salaries and tipped earnings.
* Trump announced the proposal as a [key priority](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) during a Las Vegas rally, aiming to address long-standing concerns of tipped workers.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In show of her dominance in 4th District, Boebert has out-raised and spent her five opponents combined](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Lauren Boebert [significantly outpaced](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) her Republican primary opponents in fundraising and spending in the run-up to the Colorado 4th Congressional District primary, scheduled for June 25.
* Boebert [raised $334,000](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) between April 1 and June 5, more than the combined total of $178,000 raised by her five GOP competitors. Her campaign expenditures [exceeded $632,000](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) during the same period, with a significant portion spent on TV ads and mailers.
* Boebert's financial dominance is seen as a strong indicator of her [likely victory](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in the primary, given the lack of financial and political traction among her opponents. The primary winner is expected to have a strong advantage in the November election in this heavily Republican district.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Utah Gov. Cox criticizes Denver mayor for busing migrants to Salt Lake City](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Utah Governor Spencer Cox criticized Denver Mayor Mike Johnston for [sending approximately 2,000 migrants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to Salt Lake City without proper coordination, attributing the action to broader failures in federal immigration policies.
* Governor Cox highlighted the [strain on Utah's resources](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and described all states as "border states" due to the ongoing immigration crisis.
* Denver has spent an estimated [$71 million on over 42,000 migrants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) since December 2022, as part of their efforts to manage the influx. Denver officials attempted to mitigate the situation by sending representatives to El Paso to discourage migrants from traveling to Denver.
* The [economic burden](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on Denver, including costs related to city services, education, and healthcare for migrants, ranges between $216 million and $340 million.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[Transform Colorado events slated to unite Christian, church leaders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|

* The first of three events, part of the [Transform Colorado initiative](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), will kick off on June 18 at Radiance Church in Commerce City, with guest speaker William J. Federer. Two additional events will follow on June 19 in different locations.
* The events are primarily aimed at church leaders throughout Colorado but are open to all residents. The goal is to promote and [restore Biblical values](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in public spaces.
* The [press release](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) emphasizes the importance of the upcoming November elections and encourages Christian leaders and congregants to participate in shaping the nation's future through active engagement and leadership.

Friend -
Exciting news! Our first full shipment of yard signs is in, and they’re flying out the door! I’m a big believer that yard signs aren’t just yard signs—they serve as value statements and even acts of political courage.
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240618-2-30&t=2&akid=1552%2E135344%2EF4XlYP)
When I first decided to run for office in 2018, people told me that I had no shot. It was a conservative district that had voted for Trump and had an entrenched Republican incumbent. But I ignored them, and started campaigning across the district, in blue areas, in purple areas, and in red areas that hadn’t seen a Democrat in a long time.
And something funny started to happen in those red areas. One person would take a small brave act and put out one of our lawn signs, making a statement about where they stood.
All of a sudden, you’d go back to that same neighborhood and see a few more lawn signs. And then a few more.
That first act of political courage opened the door to other people who didn’t know that their neighbors felt the same way.

It’s not enough. | | | Peter, The Biden Administration just announced a major victory for our community: Undocumented immigrants married to U.S. citizens will now be able to access lawful permanent residency without leaving the country! This is a HUGE win — one that will offer safety and protection for over half a million families. Immigrant youth continue to show that when we fight for our communities, we win. 🧡 A future where immigrants are safe and protected is possible through organizing and relentless pressure on our elected officials. It’s how we won DACA 12 years ago. It’s how we won ACA coverage for DACA recipients earlier this year. And it’s how we won this victory today. But these executive actions don’t go far enough, and we can’t stop now. We won’t rest until we have permanent protections for all 11 million undocumented people. Today, President Biden showed us meaningful change is possible, and we’re demanding that he deliver for our communities before November. | Hi Peter, it’s Susan here.

I wanted to reach out to let you know that we’re already more than halfway through the month of June.

While it might seem like any other month, in the political campaign world it marks the end of a fundraising quarter. That means at the end of June, we’ll have to report our fundraising numbers for everyone to see.

_President Trump has taken hit after hit, but he 's still standing._ He says he's honored to be in this position. He is putting everything on the line to continue fighting for America. The Deep State is doing everything they can to ensure he can't take the Oval Office on January 20th.

Juneteenth is our country's second independence day - a celebration and commemoration of the ending of slavery in the United States. A Jill Stein Administration will guarantee as a human right reparations to the descendants of African slaves for the historic crime of enslavement. Reparations is a cornerstone of the Black Agenda, but far from the only policy needed to begin to redress what has been stolen from the Black community over 400+ years. Jill and our guests will discuss pressing issues facing the Black American community and how our campaign is working together with members of the community on an agenda to facilitate Black liberation. Confirmed guests include: **Sabby Sabs** is an independent media leader in news, interviews, and commentary as the host of Sabby Sabs podcast and co-host of Revolutionary Blackout Network. **Minister Caliph Muab-El** is Executive Director of Breaking Barriers Mentoring, whose mission is to educate, uplift, and support those who are directly impacted by incarceration. He is currently leading a team of community organizers who are collecting ballot access signatures for Jill Stein in Illinois and Indiana. **Zaki Baruti** is President/General of the Universal African People's Organization, as well as a former educator in East St. Louis and a former candidate for governor of Missouri. **Marsha Coleman-Adebayo** is a former senior policy analyst for the US Environmental Protection Agency, whistleblower, and leader with the National Whistleblower Center, EPA Employees Against Racial Discrimination and the No FEAR Coalition. **Sherman Wells** is a co-founder of U.N.T.A.M.E.D, a nationwide organization dedicated to uplifting the African American community and inspire the marginalized in urban settings to envision and realize possibilities beyond their current circumstances to reclaim their futures. Please join this important conversation with a powerhouse lineup of changemakers and help fire up the fight to get our campaign for true racial justice on the ballot in Illinois, Indiana, and across the country!

#

Peter, in just a moment, we’re going to ask you to make a donation to Ruben Gallego’s campaign for U.S. Senate. Please, let us explain why this is so important:
There are less than two weeks separating us from today and the most important FEC deadline of this campaign so far, and we are tracking behind our goals.
It is absolutely essential that Ruben Gallego hit his goals ahead of that deadline, because afterwards we’ve got to show everyone our numbers — whether they’re good or bad, all of our fundraising data will be public.
If you’ve heard enough and are ready to chip in, please:
[**Can you contribute $5 to Ruben’s campaign and help him catch up to his goals before this critical deadline?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240618-2-160&t=1&akid=2500%2E734936%2E8Yove2)

Around this time of the summer we fall into what’s commonly known as the “Summer Slump.” Fundraising slows down, and it’s easy to understand why — no one wants to follow politics when they could be out enjoying themselves.
We get it, but we’ve got to try. It is absolutely critical that we convince you to pay attention, because if we don’t we’re going to have a hell of a tough time winning in November.
It could mean U.S. Senator Kari Lake. President Donald Trump. A Republican House and Senate. And an absolute nightmare for the rest of us.
This isn’t your grandpa’s GOP. They’re threatening political violence, a weaponization of the justice system against their political adversaries, and purges at all levels of government.
And that’s just what they’re saying publicly.
Ruben is doing everything he can to stop them, but he cannot do it alone. He needs your help?
[**So, please. With less than two weeks until the most important FEC deadline of the campaign so far, can you make a donation and help Ruben Gallego win in Arizona?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june24.NmHAEe&refcode=em240618-2-160&t=3&akid=2500%2E734936%2E8Yove2)

Friend, Tomorrow is Juneteenth, a day that marked the official end to chattel slavery in the South. Black Americans are still fighting for human rights and human dignity, while facing a new far-right backlash against affirmative action and reparations programs. **I’m proud to work alongside two Black champions for racial justice in Congress: Representatives Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush.** Jamaal Bowman and I have supported Cori Bush’s groundbreaking policies, including her _Reparations Now Resolution_ to recognize the federal government’s responsibility to provide reparations for enslaving and inflicting harm on people of African descent. Cori and I have also co-sponsored Jamaal’s bills to fund Black history education and to condemn the racist “great replacement theory” that inspired an anti-Black massacre in Buffalo, New York just two years ago. clean_body: Our country continues to deny Black people equal rights. | | | Friend, Tomorrow is Juneteenth, a day that marked the official end to chattel slavery in the South. Black Americans are still fighting for human rights and human dignity, while facing a new far-right backlash against affirmative action and reparations programs. I’m proud to work alongside two Black champions for racial justice in Congress: Representatives Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush. Jamaal Bowman and I have supported Cori Bush’s groundbreaking policies, including her Reparations Now Resolution to recognize the federal government’s responsibility to provide reparations for enslaving and inflicting harm on people of African descent. Cori and I have also co-sponsored Jamaal’s bills to fund Black history education and to condemn the racist “great replacement theory” that inspired an anti-Black massacre in Buffalo, New York just two years ago. Cori and Jamaal understand that the fight for Black lives and the fight for Palestinian liberation are interconnected, and they’ve been leading the push in Congress for a permanent ceasefire. Now, Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush are facing anti-ceasefire primary challengers who are taking millions from pro-Trump Republican billionaires. Their re-elections are coming up soon: Jamaal’s is next Tuesday, June 25th, and Cori’s is on August 6th. Their campaigns are powered by grassroots donations rather than corporate PAC money, and they need our support. body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38920%2E3422442%2ENLPtw3)
Derek,
As a consumer protection attorney, there’s a lot I’ve always disliked about political emails. Emails that try to shame or terrify you into donating aren’t my style.
You’ve probably seen emails that say things like:
“We need 5,238 donors from YOUR zip code.” This is fake. We have goals and deadlines, and donations from different parts of the state or country can signal support, but there’s no crazy math like this happening.
“Donate $5 today and it will be triple matched.” I promise nobody is really doing this.
“Warning: Payment incomplete.” I despise these misleading emails that make you think you’ve missed a bill. Invoking this type of fear in people is unacceptable.
I’ve introduced legislation to crack down on scam PACs, which can often be the worst offenders. Scam PACs are political organizations that exist to steal money rather than to support a cause or candidate. Their expenditures go solely to “consultants” rather than real causes, and it’s a shameful way to make a quick buck.
Here’s what is real: our fundraising deadlines and the facts we give you about the candidates I am supporting. There is urgency, yes, because we’re less than six months away from November and we need to take back the House.
Our end of quarter deadlines are some of the most important, as we have to publicly report how much we raise every three months. But our monthly and even weekly internal goals help us hit those quarterly goals, and as Election Day nears, each week’s fundraising really helps our work.
**[Truly, whatever zip code you’re in, I’d be so appreciative of your support! Can you make a contribution today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240618?refcode=em20240618-38920&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38920_3422442_NLPtw3&akid=38920%2E3422442%2ENLPtw3)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240618?refcode=em20240618-38920&refcode2=38920_3422442_NLPtw3&akid=38920%2E3422442%2ENLPtw3)
Thanks for reading, and thanks for supporting Truth to Power today.
Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240618-38920&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38920_3422442_NLPtw3&akid=38920%2E3422442%2ENLPtw3)**

Friends,

With just one week until the primary election, let me tell you: the momentum is real.

Before I got into this race, NY-01 wasn’t considered a real battleground. Now it is - if we win the primary. That’s why I’m honored to have received an unprecedented number of early endorsements - from our neighboring congressman Tom Suozzi and the New Democrat Coalition to 6 local Democratic Town Committees to three members of the Assembly and three major labor unions.

Against a self-funding candidate’s desperate negative attacks, we have run a campaign based on the politics of addition, not division. And I believe that’s what Democrats want to see - in addition to the fact that it’s the way to win a swing district.

A few months ago, a reporter for New York Magazine wondered whether voters would reward an earnest patriot with “West Wing politics.” But what I have learned is very simple, and incredibly encouraging: Finding common sense based on common ground isn’t out of style. And when voters in a swing district have a MAGA Congressman who treats his duty like a no-show job – coming together to get things done has real appeal.

Nick LaLota really wants to run against my primary opponent - because she’s already lost once by ten points. So he’s sharing some of the same false negative attacks that she’s been sending around the district. You know how I feel about that. You take bullies head on. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/realitycheck2]

We really are building the broadest possible coalition. Democrats are coming together to make sure we win this seat, and I’m honored to see the energy and optimism that comes from recognizing that Democrats can’t afford to lose this fight - because if we win here, Democrats will control the House - and we can take action to defend our democracy, protect reproductive freedom and address the affordability crisis as we strengthen the middle class.

Early voting has already started. We’re knocking doors, making phone calls, and texting voters. Our field program is in full swing trying to capture every single vote. We’re not stopping.

If you are able to, please consider making one more contribution to help with this last push. At this point we are turning every dollar into voter outreach and making the case. It’s working. And anything you can do helps. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/realitycheck2]

I’ll check in before the weekend with some final updates.

Thank you for fighting this good fight with me. I wouldn’t have it any other way.

-John

PS - if you haven’t seen our ads yet, I’m really proud of them. Please watch them ( here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlon-firstad] and here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/avlonnegativenancy] ) and make sure we have the resources to keep up the pressure in the final week.

body:
| Peter - did you see our message about Donald Trump offering substantial financial packages to at least nine witnesses involved in his criminal trials?

[**Read below for more details, and sign here to join us in demanding prosecutors indict Trump for illegal witness tampering.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87156665/480228789/-1511853353?refcode=EM_NBI_DWSPAC_20240618_PT_Tampering_0_3MO_StandwithDems_na_na_Trump2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODcwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjhjZGNjZS1iZTJkLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r9eHyYNiArHYyrx1PcjRCQGiqZAirwUIHt4EtEtZpns=&emci=0e146531-e82c-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=ef8cdcce-be2d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=5260669)
* * *
**_Begin Forwarded Message:_**

Peter,

_ProPublica_ recently reported that Donald Trump's camp gave substantial financial packages to at least nine witnesses in criminal cases against him.

ICYMI: Nancy Dahlstrom Endorsed by President Trump

ANCHORAGE, AK - The headlines are in, and everyone is talking about
President Donald Trump's endorsement
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69167&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61591> of Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom in
Alaska's at-large congressional race!

>From the Alaska Beacon
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69167&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61592> to Fox News
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69167&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61593> , America is buzzing about Lt. Governor
Dahlstrom's campaign to unseat Democrat Mary Peltola and return
conservative Alaskan leadership to Congress. Just check out some of the
headlines heralding Lt. Governor Dahlstrom's endorsement by the 45th
and soon-to-be 47th President of the United States.

"I thank President Trump for his endorsement. We have all felt the
effects from the Democratic mismanagement of our nation by Joe Biden
and Mary Peltola," said Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom in her Monday
statement. "Our southern border is a mess, ourdollars don't go as far
anymore, and our adversaries are emboldened across the globe. Now more
than ever, we need real conservative leadership in Washington to right
the ship and I look forward to working with President Trump to Make
America Great Again when we're both in Washington."

With President Trump's endorsement and backing from Republican leaders
across Alaska and America, Lt. Governor Dahlstrom is positioned to take
back this seat that President Trump won by 10 points in 2020.

Peter, It’s true what they say — Hawaii is one of the “bluest” states in the nation. Our state voted for Joe Biden by a wide margin, and we’re represented in Congress by strong Democrats (_including Mazie!)_ **But that doesn’t mean we can cruise to victory this November. Far from it.** Here’s why: In 2022, outside groups and mainland billionaires poured in more money than they ever had before to influence our elections. Friends,
Today is a historic day for immigrant families across the nation.
Earlier today, President Biden announced new executive orders that will shield undocumented spouses of U.S. citizens from deportation, and give them a pathway to citizenship.
Over half a million people in this country will be able to stay with their families because of President Biden’s executive orders today. But that’s not all: These protections will also extend to over 50,000 children of undocumented spouses.
This is transformational policy.
As an immigrant, I know firsthand the challenges historic immigration policies have posed for immigrant families. I immigrated here as a young child, and the citizenship process was incredibly difficult. So knowing that the pathway to citizenship will be more accessible to immigrants is incredible.
These life-changing policies are the reason we need President Biden to stay in office. He has continued to advocate for immigrant families and we cannot afford to lose his leadership in the White House.

Earlier today, President Biden announced new executive orders that will shield undocumented spouses of U.S. citizens from deportation, and give them a pathway to citizenship. Over half a million people in this country will be able to stay with their families because of President Biden’s executive orders today. But that’s not all: These protections will also extend to over 50,000 children of undocumented spouses. This is transformational policy. As an immigrant, I know firsthand the challenges historic immigration policies have posed for immigrant families. I immigrated here as a young child, and the citizenship process was incredibly difficult. So knowing that the pathway to citizenship will be more accessible to immigrants is incredible. These life-changing policies are the reason we need President Biden to stay in office. Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re in the middle of the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country, and we need your help to win.

We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.

Ryan Mackenzie for U.S. Congress | | | | |
---
| Friends,
I hope everyone had a wonderful Father's Day weekend. I was able to celebrate my first Father's Day as a dad with my 10-week-old baby boy, Leo.
This weekend, I was thinking about what kind of future my son will inherit. It’s clear that we need to get our country back on the right track, and that’s what’s motivating me in my run for U.S. Congress. I want to protect the middle class and the American worker. Our elected officials need to ensure that our young people have the freedom and opportunity to achieve their dreams and steer our country towards brighter days. And I want to make sure our seniors can enjoy their retirement secure in the knowledge the Social Security system they paid into will always be there for them.
My team and volunteers have been working hard in this fight, and I hope you can join us as we work to get our country back on the right track.
**Here’s what #TeamMackenzie has been up to over the last week:**
* Endorsement from the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB)
* Working with the small business community
* Visiting with the Indian American community
* Bethlehem Township Community Days

As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out to info@mackenzieforcongress.com.
---
|
---
| **Endorsed by National Federation of Independent Business**
I am extremely proud to receive the endorsement of the National Federation of Independent Business. Right now, independent business owners are bearing the brunt of Joe Biden and Susan Wild’s war against workers, taxpayers, and small businesses. They are the first to feel the pain from high prices and interest rates, and it’s making it harder than ever for them to compete with the large corporations that Biden and Wild are looking out for. That’s why the NFIB is supporting our fight — they know that we’ll fight for our local small businesses and the positive effect they have on our economy.
---
|
---
| **Working with the Small Business Community**
It was a pleasure to talk with members of our small business community and hear what they’re facing. Unfortunately, they’re facing enormous pressure from out-of-control prices, making it harder for them to grow, create new jobs, and compete. We need new leaders in Washington who who will fight for our neighborhood businesses, not just large corporations. Thank you R.L. Rippert and Associated Builders and Contractors for letting us stop by.
---
|
---
| **Visiting with the Indian American community**
This weekend I enjoyed some traditional Indian Food at the “Foods of India” event in Allentown, courtesy of the Indian American Association of the Lehigh Valley. Thank you to Monica Chibber for introducing me to so many wonderful people and delicious food.
---
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
| **Bethlehem Township Community Days**
Another great weekend spent meeting voters across the Lehigh Valley. Thank you to our incredible volunteers who helped us knock doors in Lehigh County and man the tent at Bethlehem Township Community Days.
---
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
| While our Republican candidates have come extremely close to knocking off Susan Wild in the past - even in difficult years for Republicans - now is the time we can win! As the Biden-Wild record continues to fall apart and our polling surges, we have our best chance ever. Dear Coloradans,
June is Gun Violence Awareness Month, and unfortunately, Colorado knows the impacts of senseless gun violence all too well. From the tragedy at Columbine High School to the shooting at the Aurora movie theater, our state has experienced far too much heartbreak. We must do more to prevent future tragedies.
This month we commemorate the Coloradans lost and by gun violence. May their memory always be a blessing to us.
We must take meaningful action to prevent further tragedies. I am committed to supporting these efforts and doing my part to enact meaningful change. This includes advocating for an assault weapons ban in the State of Colorado.
Together, we can build a safer Colorado for future generations.
Thank you,
Jena Griswold

Whether you gave $1 or $100, you're helping us build the campaign that we need to take on my opponents and keep Delaware and the Senate blue. In fact, it's helped fund our organizing program which will give us the resources we need to reach voters and keep Delaware blue.

We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon. But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents. And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home. But right now, we’re in the toughest reelection fight of our lives. FIRST, election experts called us the most vulnerable Democratic senators up in 2024. THEN, Mitch McConnell and his cronies said they would spend over a hundred million dollars to try to defeat us. NOW, we’re officially up against two self-funding multimillionaires who are bankrolling their campaigns themselves. We can’t write our campaigns million dollar checks. But we’ve got something better: You. Our supporters are teachers, electricians, farmers, autoworkers, you name it — who work hard every day to make a living and together, we can make a difference. Thanks for having our backs. We won’t let you down. — Jon Tester & Sherrod Brown

| Hi Peter,

As we head into summer, we wanted to provide an update on what Ami’s been up to in DC! He’s been hard at work bringing home federal dollars to help us with projects here in Sacramento County. Check out the latest from our team:
| | **→ Ami secured a $22.5 Million transportation grant for Sacramento County.** This funding will support “Green Means Go”, a multi-year program that will lower greenhouse gas emissions and improve transportation mobility in the greater Sacramento region. It will also advance four “green zone projects” that will support neighborhoods in Citrus Heights, City of Sacramento, North Highlands and Rancho Cordova.

**→ Ami also helped to secure $7.5 million in federal funding for Sacramento’s City and County Housing Authorities.** This funding will help ensure more of our residents have access to a safe and affordable place to live, and support the development and modernization of public housing throughout our district.

**→ Last month, Ami announced that the EPA has selected Sacramento City Unified School District for nearly $2.5 million in funding to purchase 8 electric school buses!** These new buses will improve air quality, reduce greenhouse gas emissions and create good-paying jobs in the Sacramento region.

**→ Ami congratulated Taiwan’s President Dr. Lai Ching-te on his inauguration.** In a statement, Ami said, “I extend my warmest congratulations to Dr. Lai Ching-te on his inauguration as President of Taiwan. Friend, My home community has never been top of mind for Washington, but that never stopped our family from believing in this community’s potential and fighting for what we deserve. Slowly but surely, we're winning that fight. We've brought hundreds of millions of dollars back to Northern Ohio, to rebuild our infrastructure, recharge our economy, and restore our environment. My parents didn't have a college education, and they never had much money. But they made a good life for us here, the same way so many Ohioans did: with hard work, perseverance, and the support of their community. **Today, I live in the same house in Toledo that they did — and I proudly represent that same community in Congress.** It's thanks to the sacrifices they made and the values they passed down to me that I'm here, friend. And it's the privilege of my life to go to work every day and fight for the community that raised me. Here's the truth: the Heartland has been overlooked and underserved for too long. That's why I'm fighting for real, transformative investments in communities like ours — investments that create good-paying jobs, protect our Great Lakes and deliver a better future for working people everywhere. I'll never stop fighting for our Heartland, friend, because this is my home too. But they made a good life for us here, the same way so many Ohioans did: with hard work, perseverance, and the support of their community. Today, I live in the same house in Toledo that they did — and I proudly represent that same community in Congress. It's thanks to the sacrifices they made and the values they passed down to me that I'm here, friend. And it's the privilege of my life to go to work every day and fight for the community that raised me. Here's the truth: the Heartland has been overlooked and underserved for too long. That's why I'm fighting for real, transformative investments in communities like ours — investments that create good-paying jobs, protect our Great Lakes and deliver a better future for working people everywhere. clean_body: See how you can take action too! Hi Peter, Ahead of critical elections for care policies this November, domestic workers from around the country have been deploying in key states to engage voters! Check out photos from recent deployments in Virginia, Nevada, and Georgia: As domestic workers turn out voters in the field, you can support their efforts by becoming a Care in Action member. Thanks to supporters like you, we’ve been able to make a huge difference in high‐stakes elections all over America. In Virginia’s 2023 state elections, volunteers including care workers activated hundreds of thousands of voters and elected 22 Care in Action endorsed candidates. This November, we can help elect candidates in our key states that will fight for care workers, but we need your help. Thank you for your support, Care in Action

# Project 2025 Wants to Attack Nato

**Every treaty that is holding up the Western World is at risk if MAGA wins in 2024.** We face a grave threat from Project 2025—Trump wants to cut America off from the rest of the world.🚨 One of the most alarming aspects of Project 2025 is its advocacy for the termination of crucial treaties like NATO and the complete closure of borders. Such actions not only undermine the collaborative efforts of nations but also jeopardize the very foundation of global diplomacy. As explicitly stated in Project 2025: **"international organizations and agreements that erode our Constitution, rule of law, or popular sovereignty should not be reformed: They should be abandoned."** Do no let their phrasing get it twisted... MAGA is attacking vital treaties for America and our allies. They might claim there is "erosion of our Constitution," but this is all a red herring to mislead the public while they tear apart vital foreign policy. Furthermore, by prioritizing the closure of borders without addressing the complexities of immigration, Project 2025 demonstrates a callous disregard for human rights and global relations. This compounded with the attempt to abandon longstanding treaties like NATO poses a real risk to our allies and destabilizes the security landscape that has been carefully constructed over the past century. It is imperative that we stand together to oppose such shortsighted and reckless actions that threaten the stability and prosperity of our world. I urge you to join me in raising awareness about the dangers of Project 2025 and advocating for policies that promote cooperation, inclusivity, and peace on the global stage. Thank you for your attention to this critical issue. Together, we can work towards a future where collaboration and understanding prevail. [**Join us in this critical battle to protect our nation from Trump’s authoritarian ambitions. Together, we can preserve the very essence of American democracy. Time is of the essence—your immediate action is crucial.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/maga-os?refcode=2025)

name: Sarah McBride
subject: We knew these attacks were coming, Peter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
I’m no stranger to the anti-trans attacks from the radical right.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240618-1&t=1&akid=829%2E587540%2EpH8goS)
Peter, it's Sarah McBride.
Last weekend on Steve Bannon’s talk show, **Marjorie Taylor Greene described me and my candidacy as a “complete evil” that will “curse” our nation.** Not because of my policy agenda. Simply because of who I am.
**Believe me, I am no stranger to these kinds of attacks from the MAGA extremists. I was the first transgender state senator in the country, and if Delaware voters elect me this November, I’ll become the first-ever openly trans member of Congress.**
I expected this from MTG and, believe me, **I won't lose sleep over what she thinks of me.**
If there’s one thing I know for sure, it’s this: I’m not running for Congress to pick fights with MAGA Republicans who want to waste the American people’s time on personal attacks and manufactured culture wars. I am running because I have a record of getting things done for Delaware — and Congress desperately needs more people who are there for the right reasons, rather than politicians stoking flames of fear and hate. **We need serious legislators in Congress, not professional provocateurs.**
I’m running to bring my results-driven approach to Washington so we can make progress on the most important issues: affordable health care and housing, paid leave and childcare, gun reform, solutions to the climate crisis, and so much more. That’s what this campaign is all about — and we’re not going to get distracted by the people who want to divide our country with their agenda of hatred.
These attacks won’t stop me from fighting for you. And even extremists like Marjorie Taylor Greene won’t stop me from bringing people together to deliver for all of us — just like I’ve done in Delaware.
**I’m heartened that Leaders We Deserve, Delaware Democrats, and folks all across the country are united behind this campaign in the face of these attacks.**
**[Peter, if you’re with me in this fight, can you make a split $5 contribution right now between Leaders We Deserve and my history-making campaign to help fight back? Together, we are stronger than any of the attacks.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240618-1?refcode=em20240618-1&amount=5&refcode2=829_587540_pH8goS&akid=829%2E587540%2EpH8goS)**

Thank you, as always, for your love and support.
Sarah McBride

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Democrats need to stiffen our spines on tax policy. My thoughts:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Warren for Senate: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/370?source=em-header&t=1001&akid=2223%2E4032634%2E9C9tSF

We are under five months away from when voters will decide the direction
our country takes on abortion, climate, and immigration. Another fight
with huge consequences is also teed up: The fight over taxes.

In 2017, Donald Trump signed his only major legislative achievement: a $2
trillion tax cut mostly sucked up by millionaires, billionaires, and giant
corporations — you know, the guys Trump is now begging for money to pay
his legal bills and fund his campaign. In 2025, many of those cuts will
expire, and — ready or not — Congress will be forced to confront big
decisions on tax policy.

The 2025 tax fight will create a huge opportunity to break with decades of
tax-cutting political orthodoxy and reshape the tax code to reflect our
nation’s values by raising taxes on the wealthy. That’s what Americans
across the country are demanding. That’s what Joe Biden is running on.
Next year, we must raise taxes on giant corporations and billionaires.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2251?refcode=EMZ20X_TAX_E_20240618_V1S1%3Famount%3D28&t=1006&akid=2223%2E4032634%2E9C9tSF ]Below I’m going to go into detail on just how critical our country’s
tax code policy is — and why this is a pivotal moment to shape the future
of our economy. I’ve spent many years advocating for making our tax code
fairer for the middle class, and I’m running for re-election this year to
keep fighting for this. Will you pitch in
$28 or any
amount to help grow our campaign and make the case for policies that make
our government work not just for the rich and powerful but for everyone?
I’m grateful to have you on this team.

I want to be crystal clear: This is about what both Republicans and
Democrats have done in years past. If Democrats take the coward’s way out
and sign our names to a half-baked deal that lets the wealthy off the
hook, it will be a huge failure — and one the American people cannot
afford.

In short, taxes reflect our values. Taxes show what — and who — we value
enough to collectively invest in. And today’s tax code reflects the values
of a handful of the wealthy and well-connected, far more than the values
of everyone else.

It is no surprise the United States ranks 31st out of 38 developed
countries in terms of tax revenue as a share of GDP. Our tax code is now
caught in a doom loop. Tax loopholes for the wealthiest individuals and
corporations mean the rich keep more and more of their money. And as the
money floods to the top, so does power. Growing piles of cash fund growing
armies of lobbyists that demand even bigger tax breaks. Cash spent on
lobbying hit a record $4.3 billion last year — fueled by billionaires
drooling over the prospect of even more lavish tax breaks in 2025. And
boy, does it work. What are the policy consequences of high-powered
lobbying and corporate-friendly senators and representatives on both sides
of the aisle? Well, we end up with tax policy that reflects the values of
the top 1% — and mostly the top 1% of the 1%. The tax doom loop also
distorts every other part of our economy.

In 2020, things started to shift. Every major Democratic candidate running
to replace Donald Trump made raising taxes on the wealthy a centerpiece of
their presidential campaigns — including Joe Biden. Enough of the tax doom
loop — candidates were willing to say no to billionaire donors. After
Biden won and a deadly pandemic rattled our economy to the core, Biden and
Democrats in Congress actually delivered. We passed tax policies that
broke with decades of bad economic and political orthodoxy — and, in doing
so, fueled the best economic recovery on the planet.

In 2022, we raised taxes on corporations for the first time in thirty
years. Democrats in Congress passed my 15% minimum tax on billion-dollar
corporations. This tax leapfrogged the usual tax loopholes and put a
minimum tax on the profits these big corporations reported to their
shareholders, meaning no more bragging to their wealthy investors about
how big their profits were, and then telling the IRS they were too poor to
pay taxes. It’s a tax change aligned with American values — and it will
raise $222 billion in new revenue to boot.

Democrats also passed a massive funding increase for the long-underfunded
IRS, so it can take on the millionaires and billionaires who have been
holding back about $150 billion each year — money they legally owe. Early
reports from that effort indicate that for every dollar invested, $10 will
be returned. And, once again, tax policy was a sharp dividing line between
the two parties: Every Democrat supported the tax increases on the rich
and every Republican voted against them. Every. Single. One.

And that sets us up for the showdown in 2025, when Congress will decide
what to do when a huge chunk of the Trump tax cuts expire, and big
decisions need to be made.

If Republicans win in November, Donald Trump has already said exactly what
will happen. He told his “rich as hell” donors — his words, not mine —
that he will give them another huge tax cut. An “upper class” tax cut, and
a “business class big tax cut.” That corporate rate, which Trump had
already slashed from 35% down to 21% — why not lower it to 15%? And why
not add a few more loopholes for Wall Street and Big Oil? The tax code is
on the auction block, with favors going to Trump’s wealthiest donors.

If Democrats win, what happens next? In the past, we eagerly cut deals
with Republicans that gave a teeny tiny tax break to middle-class
Americans and another big, fat cut to those at the top. When Ronald Reagan
got elected, for example, the Democratic House fell all over itself to
make a $10 trillion tax cut deal with him. The tax doom loop in its full
glory. Or look at the Bush tax cuts. Why did those cuts cost $8 trillion?
Because Democrats cut a deal with Republicans to make nearly all of Bush’s
temporary cuts permanent. The impact on the national debt was staggering.

Right after the deal was cut, Republicans claimed to care deeply about the
deficit. They then fabricated a debt ceiling crisis, which they used to
extract crippling budget cuts. Those cuts cost the U.S. economy more than
7 million jobs, and they helped set the stage for Donald Trump’s election
in 2016.

Republicans are running the same play again — and too many Democrats have
demonstrated just how eager we are to compromise. Earlier this year,
hoping for an increase in the Child Tax Credit to lift 400,000 kids out of
poverty — a very important goal — a number of Democrats agreed to give big
corporations $3 in tax cuts for every $1 to poor families. Republicans
tanked the deal because they believe they can get even more next year, and
that Democrats won’t have the spine to stop them.

But Democrats don’t need to be suckers this time. We can turn away from
our history of bad dealmaking, and double down on raising taxes for those
at the top. We can make the U.S. tax code reflect the values of the
American people by raising taxes for billionaires and billionaire
corporations. That’s what Joe Biden is running on for his re-election. And
it’s what the American people are demanding — loud and clear.

Four in five Americans support raising taxes on the rich — 80%. And that’s
ALL Americans, Democrats, Republicans, and independents. And take a closer
look at the Trump voters. Nearly two in three voters who pulled the lever
for Donald Trump in 2020 say they support raising taxes on the rich. If
Democrats play hardball on taxing billionaires, America will be with us.

Raising taxes on the rich to pay for other programs makes those other
programs even more popular. For example, a big investment like affordable
child care is incredibly popular — but when child care is paired with a
plan to pay for it by raising taxes on the wealthy and large corporations,
it becomes even more popular — up 4 percentage points overall, and up 7
points with independents, and 6 with Republicans. In other words, when we
talk about taxes to pay for the programs we want, we build broader support
for those programs.

At a time when people have grown cynical about Democratic promises,
showing our willingness to tax billionaires and giant corporations to pay
for those programs strengthens our credibility.

My two-cent wealth tax would pay for universal child care; cancel all
student loan debt, make technical school, two-year, and four-year colleges
free; create a $5 billion investment in historically Black colleges and
universities; and give every public K-12 school a million dollars to
invest in the way that best meets their specific needs. When we remind
people of that, we invite them to dream big for our children and for our
nation — and to reject the answer that we can’t make our country a better
place because Mark Zuckerberg and Elon Musk don’t want to pay taxes.

The possible changes to our tax code are not mysterious. Democrats have a
long list of ideas that raise taxes on the wealthy and big businesses —
raising rates, closing loopholes, strengthening minimum taxes, and
investing in the IRS.

Our redlines should also be clear: At the end of the 2025 tax reform
process, large corporations must pay higher taxes. A typical billionaire
must pay a higher tax rate than a typical middle-class family. And wealthy
tax cheats must be sweating because the IRS has enough money to enforce
the law.

Democrats have good, popular ideas about taxes. All we need is courage.
Courage to shake off half a century of running for the hills every time
the subject of taxes comes up. Courage to stand up to billionaire and
corporate donors. Courage to say to the wealthiest and most powerful
people in this country, “pay up.”

It's time to stiffen our spines. Joe Biden is right: if the 2025 tax bill
doesn’t call on wealthy people and giant corporations to shoulder a bigger
share of what it costs to run this country, Democrats should reject it
outright. And that is true no matter what crumbs the lobbyists toss our
way to sweeten a bad deal.

A little money for poor children or a modest tax cut for middle-class
families is still a lousy deal when we can’t fund child care or
infrastructure because the wealthiest among us are still sucking up
billions in tax breaks. Better to let all the Trump tax cuts expire than
be accomplices to another slash-and-burn tax bonanza for America’s
billionaires.

It’s time to talk about our values — and time to get out there and fight
for them. Donald Trump is telling rich donors that he’ll give them even
more tax breaks. He wants to build an America that works even better for
those who have already made it big. Democrats should follow Joe Biden’s
lead and double down on taxing the rich. Tax the rich so that we can build
a stronger, fairer America — an America with opportunity for everybody,
where every kid has a first-rate education, where our transportation
system isn’t the butt of jokes, and where families aren’t bankrupted by
one bad medical diagnosis. The American people are telling us that they
are ready for a tax code that promotes their values, and Democrats must be
ready to deliver.

[ https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2251?refcode=EMZ20X_TAX_E_20240618_V1S1%3Famount%3D28&t=1007&akid=2223%2E4032634%2E9C9tSF ]I’ve fought hard for this, and I’m going to continue doing everything I
can to make wealthy billionaires and corporations pay their fair share in
taxes. Your support makes this work possible. If you believe it’s time to
tax the rich, can you please pitch in
$28 or
anything you can to help grow momentum for this critical policy?

Thanks for being a part of this,

Elizabeth Warren

Facebook: https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/365?t=1002&akid=2223%2E4032634%2E9C9tSF

Why did those cuts cost $8 trillion? Because Democrats cut a deal with Republicans to make nearly all of Bush’s temporary cuts permanent. The impact on the national debt was staggering. Right after the deal was cut, Republicans claimed to care deeply about the deficit. They then fabricated a debt ceiling crisis, which they used to extract crippling budget cuts. Those cuts cost the U.S. economy more than 7 million jobs, and they helped set the stage for Donald Trump’s election in 2016. Republicans are running the same play again — and too many Democrats have demonstrated just how eager we are to compromise. Earlier this year, hoping for an increase in the Child Tax Credit to lift 400,000 kids out of poverty — a very important goal — a number of Democrats agreed to give big corporations $3 in tax cuts for every $1 to poor families. Republicans tanked the deal because they believe they can get even more next year, and that Democrats won’t have the spine to stop them. But Democrats don’t need to be suckers this time. We can turn away from our history of bad dealmaking, and double down on raising taxes for those at the top. We can make the U.S. tax code reflect the values of the American people by raising taxes for billionaires and billionaire corporations. That’s what Joe Biden is running on for his re-election. And it’s what the American people are demanding — loud and clear. Four in five Americans support raising taxes on the rich — 80%. And that’s ALL Americans, Democrats, Republicans, and independents. And take a closer look at the Trump voters. Nearly two in three voters who pulled the lever for Donald Trump in 2020 say they support raising taxes on the rich. If Democrats play hardball on taxing billionaires, America will be with us. Raising taxes on the rich to pay for other programs makes those other programs even more popular. For example, a big investment like affordable child care is incredibly popular — but when child care is paired with a plan to pay for it by raising taxes on the wealthy and large corporations, it becomes even more popular — up 4 percentage points overall, and up 7 points with independents, and 6 with Republicans. In other words, when we talk about taxes to pay for the programs we want, we build broader support for those programs. At a time when people have grown cynical about Democratic promises, showing our willingness to tax billionaires and giant corporations to pay for those programs strengthens our credibility. My two-cent wealth tax would pay for universal child care; cancel all student loan debt, make technical school, two-year, and four-year colleges free; create a $5 billion investment in historically Black colleges and universities; and give every public K-12 school a million dollars to invest in the way that best meets their specific needs. When we remind people of that, we invite them to dream big for our children and for our nation — and to reject the answer that we can’t make our country a better place because Mark Zuckerberg and Elon Musk don’t want to pay taxes. The possible changes to our tax code are not mysterious. Democrats have a long list of ideas that raise taxes on the wealthy and big businesses — raising rates, closing loopholes, strengthening minimum taxes, and investing in the IRS. Our redlines should also be clear: At the end of the 2025 tax reform process, large corporations must pay higher taxes. A typical billionaire must pay a higher tax rate than a typical middle-class family. And wealthy tax cheats must be sweating because the IRS has enough money to enforce the law. Democrats have good, popular ideas about taxes. All we need is courage. Courage to shake off half a century of running for the hills every time the subject of taxes comes up. Courage to stand up to billionaire and corporate donors. Courage to say to the wealthiest and most powerful people in this country, “pay up.” It's time to stiffen our spines. Joe Biden is right: if the 2025 tax bill doesn’t call on wealthy people and giant corporations to shoulder a bigger share of what it costs to run this country, Democrats should reject it outright. And that is true no matter what crumbs the lobbyists toss our way to sweeten a bad deal. A little money for poor children or a modest tax cut for middle-class families is still a lousy deal when we can’t fund child care or infrastructure because the wealthiest among us are still sucking up billions in tax breaks. Better to let all the Trump tax cuts expire than be accomplices to another slash-and-burn tax bonanza for America’s billionaires. It’s time to talk about our values — and time to get out there and fight for them. Donald Trump is telling rich donors that he’ll give them even more tax breaks. He wants to build an America that works even better for those who have already made it big. Democrats should follow Joe Biden’s lead and double down on taxing the rich. Tax the rich so that we can build a stronger, fairer America — an America with opportunity for everybody, where every kid has a first-rate education, where our transportation system isn’t the butt of jokes, and where families aren’t bankrupted by one bad medical diagnosis. The American people are telling us that they are ready for a tax code that promotes their values, and Democrats must be ready to deliver. [ ]I’ve fought hard for this, and I’m going to continue doing everything I can to make wealthy billionaires and corporations pay their fair share in taxes. Your support makes this work possible. If you believe it’s time to tax the rich, can you please pitch in $28 or anything you can to help grow momentum for this critical policy? body:
Folks, the primary results are in and I have some important updates to share. But before I get into that, I have to ask: **[Will you become a General Election Founding Donor of my re-election campaign by splitting a $30 donation between me and Bob Casey right now? This is going to be a tough fight, and I need you by my side.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240618-4?refcode=em20240618-4&refcode2=3299_552475_tIb507&akid=3299%2E552475%2EtIb507)**
I want to start by sharing how _profoundly grateful_ I am to officially be your Democratic nominee for the United States Senate. I’ve been serving the Commonwealth for my entire adult life — in my career as a civil rights lawyer, on Richmond City Council, as Mayor of Richmond, as Lieutenant Governor and Governor of Virginia, and now as U.S. Senator — and my passion for this work only grows with each year. Thank you for everything you’ve done to support me over the years and during this election cycle, which will be the most consequential in our lifetime. We can only make progress by working together, so it means the world to me to have you on this team.
**Now, let’s talk about my opponent.**
Virginia Republicans have nominated Hung Cao to run against me. Cao is a MAGA extremist through and through:

* He’s endorsed by Donald Trump.
* He would be an automatic vote for a national abortion ban, and wants to dismantle the Affordable Care Act and put Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block.
* He wants to release and even _seek compensation for_ convicted January 6th insurrectionists.

[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240618-4?refcode=em20240618-4&refcode2=3299_552475_tIb507&akid=3299%2E552475%2EtIb507)
Cao isn’t new to Virginia politics — in 2022, he ran against my friend Jennifer Wexton in VA’s 10th Congressional District and proved himself as a strong grassroots fundraiser, bringing in millions of dollars even as other Republican candidates, often with more national support, struggled to do the same.
This time around, Cao won’t be hurting for national support. He’s Trump’s hand-picked candidate, and you can bet that the rest of the GOP will be right behind him funneling millions of dollars to Virginia in the push to unseat me.
**[We cannot afford to get complacent with a candidate like Hung Cao on the ballot, so I’m asking you to split a donation between me and Bob Casey right now to become a General Election Founding Donor of my re-election campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240618-4?refcode=em20240618-4&refcode2=3299_552475_tIb507&akid=3299%2E552475%2EtIb507)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240618-4?refcode=em20240618-4&refcode2=3299_552475_tIb507&akid=3299%2E552475%2EtIb507)**
Look, I’m running for re-election because I love Virginia. I love the people of this Commonwealth, from Abingdon to Arlington and everywhere in between, and I believe in us.
In the face of a Republican party that’s hellbent on tearing down our rights and even our very democracy, I believe we are and will continue to be _stand-up_ people. We stand up for what’s right, for economic opportunity, for democracy and equality, and for each other.
I am determined to win re-election this year in part because my opponent has made it clear that he is not a stand-up leader. It’s clear even from how he operates on the campaign trail — refusing to attend a candidate forum in Abingdon because he deemed it “ridonkulous” to drive there from his home in Northern Virginia and ridiculing the Staunton newspaper as “podunk”?? That’s not the leadership our Commonwealth deserves.
**Right now, I need your support to defeat my extremist opponent and keep my seat in the Senate — because we’ve got a lot more work left to do in this fight to stand up for each other.**
**Will you become a General Election Founding Donor? You can contribute to me and Bob Casey at this link:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240618-4?refcode=em20240618-4](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240618-4?refcode=em20240618-4&refcode2=3299_552475_tIb507&akid=3299%2E552475%2EtIb507)**
Thank you so much — from the bottom of my heart.
Now let’s go win this!
— Tim Kaine
